name: 愛山渓温泉
location: 北海道 上川郡上川町
sales_point: 安足間川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。大自然に囲まれた静寂な環境にある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the valley of the Asakuma River, surrounded by the tranquility of nature.

name: 阿寒湖温泉
location: 北海道 釧路市
sales_point: 阿寒町北部、阿寒湖の南岸に位置する温泉地。阿寒観光の最大の宿泊基地。マリモの繁殖地として有名。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the southern shore of Lake Akan in the northern part of Akan Town, serving as the main accommodation base for Akan tourism, famous for being a breeding ground for marimo.

name: 旭温泉
location: 北海道 天塩郡遠別町
sales_point: 天塩山系の冨本に位置する閑静な温泉地。天然ガス掘削の際に湧き出した。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring offers two distinct types of natural spring water, including a black, skin-smoothing "Fujimi-no-yu" and a reddish-brown, warming "Asahi-no-yu." They also highlight the reasonable admission fee, with discounts available for JAF members, and the peaceful, natural atmosphere. Guests mention the friendly staff and the availability of a restaurant and souvenir shop.
sales_point_en: A quiet hot spring area located in the foothills of the Teshio mountain range, which emerged during natural gas drilling.

name: 旭川温泉
location: 北海道 旭川市
sales_point: ＪＲ旭川駅前の買物公園の中にある温泉地。交通の便が良く、ビジネス客の利用も多い。
review_summary:
Guests consistently praise this spa hotel for its wide variety of unique baths, including radium, ozone, and herbal options, and note that some rooms feature private open-air baths. They also highlight the friendly staff and the extensive retro game and manga corners.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the shopping park in front of JR Asahikawa Station, convenient for transportation and popular among business travelers.

name: 旭岳温泉
location: 北海道 上川郡東川町
sales_point: 道内最高峰、旭岳の中腹標高1050ｍに位置する温泉地。登山客や観光客、スキー客などで通年賑わいを見せる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at an elevation of 1050 meters on the slopes of Asahidake, the highest peak in Hokkaido, bustling year-round with climbers, tourists, and skiers.

name: 朝里川温泉
location: 北海道 小樽市
sales_point: 小樽市街中心部の南東、朝里川河畔の山あいに位置する温泉地。地の利と環境の良さから静養地として好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains along the Asarigawa River, southeast of Otaru city center, ideal for relaxation due to its advantageous location and pleasant environment.

name: 芦別温泉
location: 北海道 芦別市
sales_point: 大自然に囲まれた環境の良い温泉地。都会の喧騒から解放された快適なスペース。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers a wide variety of saunas, including barrel and salt saunas, and features spacious indoor and outdoor baths with unique cold spring water. Guests also highlight the extensive relaxation areas with free drinks, manga, and massage chairs, along with delicious meals and attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the service can be inefficient.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area surrounded by nature, providing a comfortable space away from the hustle and bustle of the city. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 網走湖畔温泉
location: 北海道 網走市
sales_point: 国定公園の網走湖畔の名勝地に位置する温泉地。網走湖やオホーツク海を一望でき、眺望に優れた環境。網走観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a scenic spot along the lakeside of Abashiri, within a national park, offering excellent views of Lake Abashiri and the Sea of Okhotsk, making it a suitable base for Abashiri tourism.

name: 幾春別温泉
location: 北海道 三笠市
sales_point: 三笠市の西部、幾春別川沿いに湧く素朴な佇まいの温泉。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring inn offers delicious duck hot pot and satisfying Japanese-style breakfasts, along with a variety of modern shower heads. Guests also highlight the reasonable prices, clean facilities, and quiet, relaxing atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the outdoor bath can be buggy.
sales_point_en: A simple hot spring that springs along the Ikushunbetsu River in the western part of Mikasa City.

name: 生田原温泉
location: 北海道 紋別郡遠軽町
sales_point: 生田原駅前に位置する温泉地。バスタオル、手ぬぐい、タオル貸出付きで日帰り入浴を500円で実施。気軽に立ち寄れる。
review_summary:
People say this hotel's hot spring baths offer a unique, slippery texture that leaves skin feeling smooth, with various temperature options and a medicinal bath. They also highlight the friendly staff, delicious meals, and the availability of a bedrock bath.

Some reviews mention the restaurant service can be inefficient.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in front of Ikutahara Station, offering day-use bathing for 500 yen, including rental of bath towels and hand towels, making it easy to drop by.

name: 石狩温泉
location: 北海道 石狩市
sales_point: 石狩湾を目の前にした弁天町に位置する温泉地。石狩、小樽観光拠点に好適。冬は名物石狩鍋等が味わうことができる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring features a wide variety of baths, including indoor, open-air, jacuzzi, and reclining options, with a unique brown, smooth water that leaves skin feeling soft. They also highlight the adorable capybara that guests can observe, and the delicious, reasonably priced lunch buffet.

Other reviews mention the staff can be impolite.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in Benten Town, facing Ishikari Bay, suitable as a base for Ishikari and Otaru tourism. In winter, you can enjoy the local specialty, Ishikari Nabe.

name: 泉郷温泉
location: 北海道 千歳市
sales_point: 千歳の北東郊外、緑豊かな田園地帯にある温泉地。
review_summary: People say this onsen features two distinct, highly concentrated hot springs: a dark, coffee-colored sodium bicarbonate spring and a slightly salty sodium chloride spring, both available for drinking. They also highlight the reasonable 600 yen entry fee and the friendly, helpful staff. Visitors mention the small, intimate bath areas, which are perfect for a relaxing soak.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the lush rural area northeast of Chitose.

name: 岩尾別温泉
location: 北海道 斜里郡斜里町
sales_point: イワウベツ川上流の山あいに位置する温泉地。自由に入ることができる露天風呂がある。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring features three tiered pools with varying temperatures, allowing for a customized bathing experience in a natural setting. They also highlight the free admission and convenient access near a hotel and parking.

Some reviews mention the location can be closed due to bear activity.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains upstream of the Iwaobetsu River, featuring an open-air bath that can be accessed freely.

name: 岩内温泉
location: 北海道 岩内郡岩内町
sales_point: ニセコ積丹小樽海岸国定公園の中程にある岩内岳ふもとの高原温泉。温泉に入りながら日本海や積丹半島の眺望が楽しめるロケーションが人気。いわない国際スキー場に隣接。
review_summary:
People say this inn offers delicious, high-quality meals, especially the local seafood and "ne-hokke" fish, and features a hot spring with soft, skin-friendly water. Guests also highlight the quiet, relaxing atmosphere, clean facilities, and attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the outdoor bath can be closed.
sales_point_en: A highland hot spring located at the foot of Iwanai-dake in the middle of the Niseko-Shakotan-Otaru Coast National Park, popular for its location where you can enjoy views of the Sea of Japan and the Shakotan Peninsula while soaking in the hot spring, adjacent to Iwanai International Ski Resort.

name: 薄別温泉
location: 北海道 札幌市
spa_quality: カルシウム・ナトリウム－炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point: 定山渓温泉の南西5キロ、薄別川沿いに位置する温泉地。山の中の一軒宿で閑静な環境。
review_summary: Guests mention this hotel offers spacious, spotless rooms with private onsens and beautiful forest views, providing a quiet and relaxing atmosphere. They also highlight the delicious Italian dinners and hearty Japanese breakfasts, along with thoughtful complimentary snacks and drinks. Visitors consistently praise the warm, attentive, and professional staff, noting their excellent service and hospitality.
spa_quality_en: カルシウム・ナトリウム－炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Usuzumi River, 5 kilometers southwest of Jozankei Onsen, in a quiet environment with a single inn in the mountains.

name: ウズラ温泉
location: 北海道 桧山郡厚沢部町
sales_point: 畑の真ん中に位置する温泉地。環境に恵まれた町内で一番新しい温泉。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the middle of a field, the newest hot spring in the town blessed with a good environment.

name: 歌登温泉
location: 北海道 枝幸郡枝幸町
sales_point: 歌登町北東部に位置する健康回復村にある温泉地。ゴルフ場、スキー場、テニスコート、キャンプ場があり、大人から小人まで一日中楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a health recovery village in the northeastern part of Utanobu Town, featuring a golf course, ski resort, tennis courts, and a campground, providing fun for both adults and children all day long.

name: ウトロ温泉
location: 北海道 斜里郡斜里町
sales_point: オホーツク海を見下ろす高台に位置する温泉地。知床観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a hill overlooking the Sea of Okhotsk, suitable as a base for Shiretoko tourism.

name: 海別温泉
location: 北海道 斜里郡斜里町
sales_point: ウナベツ自然休養村管理センター内に位置する温泉地。ウナベツスキー場に隣接している。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring features three tiered pools with varying temperatures, allowing for a customized bathing experience in a natural setting. They also highlight the free admission and convenient access near a hotel and parking.

Some reviews mention the location can be closed due to bear activity.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located within the Unabetsu Nature Recreation Village Management Center, adjacent to the Unabetsu Ski Resort.

name: 馬追温泉
location: 北海道 夕張郡長沼町
sales_point: 馬追山の南方に位置する温泉地。ゴルフ場やスキー場が近い。前庭の桜は魅力的。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located south of Umaoi Mountain, close to golf courses and ski resorts, with attractive cherry blossoms in the front yard.

name: 浦臼温泉
location: 北海道 樺戸郡浦臼町
sales_point: 浦臼町の南東、鶴沼畔に位置する温泉地。男女各浴場から鶴沼の四季折々の風景を眺めることが出来る。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers an affordable entry fee, features a clean facility with a sauna and a very cold water bath, and provides views of Tsurunuma Park from the bath.

Other reviews mention the facility can be dated and crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located southeast of Urausu Town, by the shores of Tsurunuma, where visitors can enjoy the seasonal landscapes of Tsurunuma from both men's and women's baths.

name: 浦幌留真温泉
location: 北海道 十勝郡浦幌町
sales_point: 浦幌川支流、留真川沿いに位置する温泉地。露天風呂からは四季の美しい自然や満天の星空が楽しめる。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a high-alkaline spring water that leaves skin feeling smooth and soft, along with clean and modern facilities. They also highlight the reasonable 500 yen admission fee, which includes shampoo, conditioner, and body soap. Guests mention the staff are friendly and helpful, and the soft-serve ice cream is delicious.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Rumma River, a tributary of the Urahoro River. Visitors can enjoy beautiful natural scenery and a starry sky from the outdoor baths.

name: 枝幸温泉
location: 北海道 枝幸郡枝幸町
sales_point: 三笠山スキー場の麓の高台に位置する温泉地。オホーツク海が一望でき、冬には流氷も見ることができる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers a clean environment, delicious meals, and a well-maintained public bath with strong shower pressure and various tubs. They also highlight the attentive staff and the reasonable price for day-use hot spring access.

Other reviews mention the shower pressure can be too strong.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area situated on a high ground at the foot of Mikasa Mountain Ski Resort, offering a panoramic view of the Sea of Okhotsk, with drift ice visible in winter.

name: 恵山温泉
location: 北海道 函館市
sales_point: 渡島半島の南東端に位置する温泉地。活火山「恵山」の麓に広がる温泉郷で、国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the southeastern tip of the Oshima Peninsula, sprawling at the foot of the active volcano 'Esan', designated as a national health resort.

name: 恵山岬温泉
location: 北海道 函館市
sales_point: 津軽海峡を望む海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。風光明媚な環境にあり、公営の日帰りの保養施設も整備されている。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers two distinct hot spring sources, with both private and public baths providing stunning ocean views and a variety of bathing options. They also highlight the delicious, fresh seafood meals, the attentive staff, and the convenient complimentary shuttle service to and from Hakodate.

Some reviews mention the upgraded dinner course can be disappointing.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the coast overlooking the Tsugaru Strait, set in a picturesque environment with public day-use facilities available, also designated as a national health resort.

name: 江部乙温泉
location: 北海道 滝川市
sales_point: 滝川市の中心部、江部乙駅前に位置する温泉地。エベオツはアイヌ語で「鉱泉の湧出する所」の意味。古くから湯治に利用され、日帰りの利用も好評。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers excellent quality hot spring water, including various temperature baths, a cold spring bath, and a sauna. They also highlight the affordable day-use fee and the nostalgic, retro atmosphere.

Some reviews mention the facilities can be neglected.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the center of Takikawa City, in front of Ebeotsu Station. The name Ebeotsu means 'the place where mineral springs emerge' in the Ainu language. It has been used for healing for a long time and is popular for day-use.

name: 江別温泉
location: 北海道 江別市
sales_point: 石狩川の南岸に位置する温泉地。江別駅前にある旅館が湯元で、近くの銭湯にも温泉がひかれている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a wide variety of baths, including a spacious main bath, jet baths, and multiple outdoor rotenburo, with a strong chloride spring that provides excellent heat retention. They also highlight the affordable 500 yen admission, ample parking, and extensive relaxation areas with manga and floor heating.

Some reviews mention the facility can be crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the southern bank of the Ishikari River. The ryokan in front of Ebetsu Station is the source of the hot spring, and nearby public baths also have hot spring water.

name: 大沼温泉
location: 北海道 亀田郡七飯町
sales_point: 大沼の西畔に位置する温泉地。駒ヶ岳を遠くに望み展望が良い。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers spacious, clean rooms with stunning views of Mount Komagatake and a relaxing outdoor hot spring overlooking a pond. They also highlight the delicious breakfast buffet, especially the freshly made onigiri, and the friendly, attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the facilities can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the western shore of Onuma, offering good views of Mount Komagatake in the distance.

name: 大船温泉
location: 北海道 函館市
sales_point: 大船川の上流に位置する温泉地。乳白色の湯があふれている。静かな環境にあり、保養・静養に好適。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers two types of natural hot springs, a milky white sulfur spring and a clear bicarbonate spring, both free-flowing and excellent for skin. Visitors highlight the reasonable day-use fees and the convenient set plans that include meals or soft-serve ice cream. They also mention the staff are kind and the atmosphere is relaxing.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located upstream of the Ofuna River, featuring milky white waters. It is set in a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 大森温泉
location: 北海道 函館市
sales_point: 函館市の市街地のすぐ側に位置する温泉地。大森浜の漁り火の眺めを楽しむことが出来る。
review_summary: Guests mention this hotel features a well-maintained onsen with a comfortable water temperature, a sauna, and an open-air bath. They also highlight the excellent cost performance for overnight stays and the polite, helpful staff.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located right next to the city center of Hakodate, where visitors can enjoy views of the fishing lights at Omori Beach.

name: 沖里河温泉
location: 北海道 深川市
sales_point: 音江山のふもとに位置する温泉地。効能は神経痛、胃腸病、皮膚炎などで、根強いファンが多い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Otoe. It is known for its therapeutic effects on neuralgia, gastrointestinal diseases, and dermatitis, attracting many loyal fans.

name: 奥屈斜路温泉
location: 北海道 網走郡津別町
sales_point: 津別町の北東端にある津別峰の麓の高台に位置する温泉地。大自然に囲まれた閑静な環境。
review_summary: People say this onsen ryokan offers a variety of baths, including indoor, outdoor, and private options, with a smooth, skin-softening alkaline water quality. They also highlight the peaceful forest setting, where guests can observe various wild animals and birds from the large windows. Visitors appreciate the reasonable prices for day-use and the attentive staff.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a high ground at the foot of Tsubetsu Peak in the northeastern part of Tsubetsu Town, surrounded by nature in a tranquil environment.

name: 奥美利河温泉
location: 北海道 瀬棚郡今金町
sales_point: ピリカベツ川沿いに位置する山峡の温泉地。大自然に囲まれた静寂な環境にある。
sales_point_en: A mountain valley hot spring area located along the Pirikabetsu River, set in a serene environment surrounded by nature.

name: おけと湖温泉
location: 北海道 常呂郡置戸町
sales_point: 置戸町の西方、おけと湖畔にある温泉地。大自然の緑に囲まれ、閑静な環境。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a wide variety of baths, including spacious indoor and outdoor options with comfortable reclining baths, and a sauna. They also highlight the reasonable 600 yen admission fee, free lockers, and complimentary shampoo, conditioner, and body soap. Guests mention the clean facilities, delicious food at the attached restaurant, and the availability of local produce and soft-serve ice cream.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the western side of Oketo Town, by the shores of Lake Oketo, surrounded by lush nature in a quiet environment.

name: 長流枝温泉
location: 北海道 河東郡音更町
sales_point: 音更町東端部の山あいに位置する温泉地。泉質は十勝川温泉と同じモール泉。
review_summary:
Visitors say this roadside station offers a unique mixed-gender spa with moor onsen, a free footbath, and a variety of delicious food options like freshly fried curry bread. They also highlight the clean, stylish facilities and the wide selection of local souvenirs.

Other reviews mention the staff can be unhelpful.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountainous region at the eastern edge of Otofuke Town, with the same mineral quality as Tokachigawa Onsen.

name: 長万部温泉
location: 北海道 山越郡長万部町
sales_point: 長万部駅から市街地にかけて広がる温泉地。観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area that spreads from Chōmambe Station to the city center, making it a suitable base for tourism.

name: オソウシ温泉
location: 北海道 上川郡新得町
sales_point: 新得町の北西、十勝川の支流オソウシ川河畔にある温泉地。閑静な山あいの古くからの湯治場。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located northwest of Shintoku Town, by the banks of the Osoushi River, a quiet and historic healing spot in the mountains.

name: 小樽温泉
location: 北海道 小樽市
sales_point: 小樽市街北東部、海岸沿いの高台に位置する温泉地。小樽港を一望することが出来る。公衆浴場は市内に点在している。
review_summary: Guests mention this ryokan offers exquisite cuisine, beautiful gardens, and well-maintained onsen facilities, including private and public baths. They also highlight the exceptional hospitality and attentive staff, who provide thoughtful service and practical assistance. Visitors appreciate the all-inclusive amenities, such as complimentary drinks, snacks, and unique activities like fire pit roasting.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a high ground along the coast in the northeastern part of Otaru City, offering a panoramic view of Otaru Port, with public baths scattered throughout the city.

name: 尾岱沼温泉
location: 北海道 野付郡別海町
sales_point: 別海町の北東、野付湾沿いに位置する温泉地。港を一望することが出来、野付湾でとれる北海シマエビが美味。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northeastern part of Bekkai Town, along Notsuke Bay, offering views of the port and delicious Hokkaido shrimp caught in Notsuke Bay.

name: 音更温泉
location: 北海道 河東郡音更町
sales_point: 音更町の市街地に位置する温泉地。数カ所の施設が点在している。泉質は十勝川温泉と同じモール泉。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a variety of baths, including a hot bath, electric bath, bubble bath, and open-air bath, with many finding the moor spring water to be very soothing. They also highlight the affordable 500 yen entry fee, the availability of free shampoo and body soap, and the convenient long operating hours.

Some reviews mention the facility can be crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the city center of Otofuke Town, with several facilities scattered around. The mineral quality is the same as Tokachigawa Onsen.

name: 帯広温泉
location: 北海道 帯広市
sales_point: 帯広市の市街地に点在する施設の総称。温泉を利用した公衆浴場も多い。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a wide variety of baths, including spacious indoor and outdoor options, saunas, and unique features like electric baths. They also highlight the affordable 500 yen entry fee and the delicious food, especially the ramen and soft-serve ice cream.

Some reviews mention it can be crowded.
sales_point_en: A collective term for facilities scattered throughout the city of Obihiro, featuring many public baths utilizing hot springs.

name: オホーツクオムイ温泉
location: 北海道 紋別郡雄武町
sales_point: オホーツク海に面する雄武町の日の出岬に位置する温泉地。一軒宿の「ホテル日の出岬」があり、内湯と露天風呂からはオホーツク海を一望できる。
sales_point_en: Located at Hinode Cape in Omu Town facing the Sea of Okhotsk, this hot spring area features the 'Hotel Hinode Misaki' with indoor and outdoor baths offering a panoramic view of the sea.

name: 温根湯温泉
location: 北海道 北見市
sales_point: 無加川の清流沿いに位置する温泉地。オンネユはアイヌ語で「大きな湯が湧き出す所」の意味。自然環境に恵まれ、エゾムラサキツツジの群生地がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the clear stream of the Mukawa River. 'Onneyu' means 'a place where large hot water springs out' in the Ainu language, surrounded by a rich natural environment and a habitat for Ezo purple azaleas.

name: 貝取澗温泉
location: 北海道 久遠郡せたな町
sales_point: 貝取澗川沿いの閑静な山あいに位置する温泉地。奇岩の続く海岸まで徒歩5分で自然環境に恵まれている。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: A tranquil hot spring area located along the Kaitorikan River, just a 5-minute walk to the coast with unique rock formations, blessed with a natural environment. A national health resort.

name: 桂沢温泉
location: 北海道 三笠市
sales_point: 三笠市の西部桂沢湖の湖畔にある温泉地。桂沢湖を一望でき、大自然に囲まれた環境。特に秋の紅葉は素晴らしい。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring inn offers delicious duck hot pot and satisfying Japanese-style breakfasts, along with a variety of modern shower heads. Guests also highlight the reasonable prices, clean facilities, and quiet, relaxing atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the outdoor bath can be buggy.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the shores of Lake Katsurazawa in the western part of Mikasa City, offering a view of the lake and surrounded by nature. The autumn foliage is particularly stunning.

name: 桂沢湯の元温泉
location: 北海道 三笠市
sales_point: 幾春別川上流の河畔にある温泉地。山の緑に囲まれた閑静な環境。名物料理の合鴨鍋が美味。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring inn offers delicious duck hot pot and satisfying Japanese-style breakfasts, along with a variety of modern shower heads. Guests also highlight the reasonable prices, clean facilities, and quiet, relaxing atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the outdoor bath can be buggy.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the upper reaches of the Ikushunbetsu River, surrounded by the greenery of the mountains in a quiet environment. The specialty dish, duck hot pot, is delicious.

name: 鹿の子温泉
location: 北海道 常呂郡置戸町
sales_point: 置戸町のほぼ中央に位置する温泉地。ひなびた雰囲気で、岩風呂が自慢。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a wide variety of baths, including spacious indoor and outdoor options with comfortable reclining baths, and a sauna. They also highlight the reasonable 600 yen admission fee, free lockers, and complimentary shampoo, conditioner, and body soap. Guests mention the clean facilities, delicious food at the attached restaurant, and the availability of local produce and soft-serve ice cream.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located almost in the center of Oketo Town, featuring a rustic atmosphere and boasting rock baths.

name: 上登別温泉
location: 北海道 登別市
sales_point: 登別温泉からカルルス温泉へ向かう途中にある温泉地。原生林に囲まれた閑静な環境で太平洋を望む景勝地。
review_summary: Visitors say this volcanic valley offers breathtaking, otherworldly scenery with steam rising from the ground and bubbling hot springs. They also highlight the well-maintained walking paths, making it easy to explore the dramatic landscape and enjoy the unique atmosphere. Guests mention the free entry and convenient parking for 500 yen, which is valid for both the valley and Oyunuma Pond.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the way from Noboribetsu Onsen to Karurusu Onsen, surrounded by primeval forests and offering a quiet environment with views of the Pacific Ocean.

name: 上の湯温泉
location: 北海道 二海郡八雲町
sales_point: 落部川の上流の山あいに位置する温泉地。自然環境が良く、3000坪に及ぶ素晴らしい庭園がある秘湯。川べりには野天風呂もある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains upstream of the Otobe River, known for its excellent natural environment and a wonderful garden spanning 3000 tsubo. There are also outdoor baths by the river.

name: 神居岩温泉
location: 北海道 留萌市
sales_point: 留萌川北側の山あいに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で、保養・療養に好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen hotel offers excellent quality hot springs, delicious and voluminous meals, and friendly, attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the building can be neglected and lack air conditioning.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains on the north side of the Rumoi River, in a quiet environment suitable for recuperation and therapy.

name: 神威脇温泉
location: 北海道 奥尻郡奥尻町
sales_point: 奥尻島の西側の海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。青く澄み渡る日本海を一望できる。日本海に沈む夕日も絶景。
review_summary: People say this hot spring facility offers abundant, free-flowing natural hot spring water with a high iron content, and features both a hot bath on the first floor and a slightly cooler observation bath on the second floor with views of the fishing port. Visitors also highlight the reasonable 500 yen admission fee and the friendly staff. They also like the relaxing atmosphere, often finding it uncrowded or even private.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the western coast of Okushiri Island, offering a panoramic view of the clear blue Japan Sea. The sunset over the sea is also a spectacular sight.

name: 亀川温泉
location: 北海道 上磯郡木古内町
sales_point: 山あいに位置する温泉地。自然環境が良く、森林浴が楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains, surrounded by a good natural environment, perfect for forest bathing.

name: かもい岳温泉
location: 北海道 歌志内市
sales_point: 神威岳東側山麓に位置する温泉地。かもい岳国際スキー場に隣接している。市街地からも近い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Kamoi on the eastern side, adjacent to the Kamoi Dake International Ski Resort and close to the city center.

name: 茅沼温泉
location: 北海道 川上郡標茶町
sales_point: 釧路湿原国立公園内に位置する温泉地。シラルトロ湖の北岸にあり、眺望が良い。豊富な湯量を誇る。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located within the Kushiro Shitsugen National Park, on the northern shore of Lake Shirautoron, offering good views and boasting abundant hot spring water.

name: カルルス温泉
location: 北海道 登別市
sales_point: 世界的に高名なチェコのカルルスバードにちなんで名づけられた温泉地。千歳川の渓谷沿いの閑静な環境にある。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including open-air options, with a mild, colorless, and odorless spring water that leaves skin feeling soft. They also highlight the reasonable prices, free lockers, and available amenities like shampoo and dryers. Guests mention the clean facilities and the quiet, relaxing atmosphere, especially compared to busier onsen areas.
sales_point_en: Named after the world-renowned Czech spa town of Karlovy Vary, this hot spring area is located in a quiet environment along the Chitose River gorge. A national health resort.

name: 川上温泉
location: 北海道 虻田郡京極町
sales_point: 尻別川沿いに位置する温泉地。国道276号線沿いにあり、羊蹄山の眺望がよい。保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Shiribetsu River, conveniently situated along National Route 276, with good views of Mount Yotei, suitable for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 川北温泉
location: 北海道 河西郡芽室町
sales_point: 芽室町市街の北側に位置する温泉地。近くに十勝川が流れる平原ののどかな環境にあり、保養・休養にも好適。芽室ICからも近くアクセスに便利。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located to the north of Memuro Town, in a peaceful environment with the Tokachi River flowing nearby, suitable for recuperation and relaxation. Convenient access from Memuro IC.

name: 川湯温泉
location: 北海道 川上郡弟子屈町
sales_point: 屈斜路湖と摩周湖の中間に位置する温泉地。針葉樹林に囲まれ自然環境が良い。湯量が豊富で湯煙と硫黄の臭いと湯の川が情緒深い。観光拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located between Lake Kussharo and Lake Mashu, surrounded by coniferous forests with a good natural environment. Abundant hot spring water with the scent of sulfur and the river adds to the charm, making it suitable as a tourist base.

name: 俄虫温泉
location: 北海道 桧山郡厚沢部町
sales_point: 厚沢部川の渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。古くからある温泉で、露天風呂が人気。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the stream of the Atsubetsu River, known for its long history and popular outdoor baths.

name: 木古内温泉
location: 北海道 上磯郡木古内町
sales_point: 津軽海峡を一望できる海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。眺望が良い。
review_summary:
People say this onsen ryokan offers delicious, fresh seafood and generous meal portions, with a relaxing hot spring that leaves skin smooth, and staff who are kind and attentive.

Other reviews mention the onsen can be overpriced and small.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the coast with a view of the Tsugaru Strait, offering excellent scenery.

name: 北桧山温泉
location: 北海道 久遠郡せたな町
sales_point: 北檜山町市街地の中心部に位置する温泉地。豊かな環境に恵まれた本格的なスパホテル。森林浴も楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers clean and spacious hot spring baths with various temperatures, saunas, and open-air baths. Guests also highlight the delicious and satisfying meals, good value, and attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the air conditioning can be unavailable.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the center of Kitahiyama Town, surrounded by a rich environment. A genuine spa hotel where you can also enjoy forest bathing.

name: 北見温泉
location: 北海道 北見市
sales_point: 北見市の中心部の西方に位置し、市街地の中に位置する温泉地。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers a natural hot spring with skin-smoothing water, a sauna with auto-löyly, and complimentary "yonaki soba" (night noodles) and ice cream. They also highlight the convenient location near the station and restaurants, and the clean, well-maintained rooms.

Some reviews mention the bath area can be small.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located to the west of the center of Kitami City, situated within the urban area.

name: 北村温泉
location: 北海道 岩見沢市
sales_point: 北村の中心、村役場の近くに位置する温泉地。沸かさず、薄めずの温泉は体の芯から温まる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has excellent quality hot springs, with many highlighting the strong saline water that warms the body to its core. They also appreciate the clean facilities, delicious restaurant food, and the option for early morning bathing.

Some reviews mention the staff can be impolite.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located near the center of Kitamura, close to the village office. The natural hot spring warms you from the core without being heated or diluted.

name: 北湯沢温泉
location: 北海道 伊達市
sales_point: 長流川の渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。自然に恵まれた閑静な環境にある。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located along the Nagauragawa River. It is situated in a quiet environment blessed with nature and designated as a national health resort.

name: 協和温泉
location: 北海道 上川郡愛別町
sales_point: 伏古山の山裾に位置する温泉地。自然に恵まれた閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a rare natural carbonated cold spring, with a small, dedicated tub for the unique, warming water. They also highlight the delicious mushroom dishes, friendly staff, and reasonable 600 yen day-use fee.

Some reviews mention the small soaking bath can be limited to one person.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located at the foot of Fushikoyama, in a quiet environment blessed with nature, ideal for relaxation and therapy.

name: 清里温泉
location: 北海道 斜里郡清里町
sales_point: 清里町の中心部に位置する温泉地。清里町駅のすぐ側。周辺にはスポーツ施設が充実している。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers spacious, clean rooms and a variety of well-maintained indoor baths with different temperatures, including a sauna. Guests also highlight the reasonable prices, delicious restaurant meals, and convenient parking.

Some reviews mention the breakfast can be disappointing.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the center of Kiyosato Town, right next to Kiyosato Station. The area is well-equipped with sports facilities.

name: キロロ温泉
location: 北海道 余市郡赤井川村
sales_point: 赤井川村の西部に位置する温泉地。キロロの森を一望できる露天風呂が完備されている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the western part of Akaiwa Village, featuring an open-air bath with a panoramic view of Kiroro Forest.

name: 屈足温泉
location: 北海道 上川郡新得町
sales_point: 新得町の西部の屈足湖の湖畔に位置する温泉地。屈足湖を一望できる露天風呂がある。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers spacious, clean, and recently renovated rooms, along with excellent hot springs featuring saunas and open-air baths. Guests also highlight the delicious and satisfying meals, the peaceful natural surroundings, and the friendly, attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the indoor heating can be insufficient.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located on the shores of Lake Kuttari in the western part of Shintoku Town, with an open-air bath offering a view of the lake.

name: 倶知安温泉
location: 北海道 虻田郡倶知安町
sales_point: ＪＲ倶知安駅の西方、旭ヶ丘スキー場のすぐ近くに位置する温泉地。倶知安の町内に近くビジネス、観光拠点に便利。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located west of JR Kutchan Station, very close to Asahigaoka Ski Resort, making it convenient for business and tourism.

name: 栗山温泉
location: 北海道 夕張郡栗山町
sales_point: 栗山町の市街地に位置する温泉地。泉質は弱食塩泉で肌に優しい。露天風呂が好評。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has good quality hot spring water with varying temperatures, offers a wide range of facilities including a kids' play area and a relaxation space with hammocks, and provides good service from the staff.

Other reviews mention the baths can be poorly maintained and the water can be cold.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the urban area of Kuriyama Town. The water quality is a mild saline spring, gentle on the skin, and the open-air bath is popular.

name: 宮内温泉
location: 北海道 島牧郡島牧村
sales_point: 泊川沿いの山あいに位置する温泉地。ゾウの花子が湯治していた温泉で知られる。露天風呂がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the mountains along the Tomari River, known for being the place where the elephant Hanako underwent hot spring therapy. It features an open-air bath.

name: 見市温泉
location: 北海道 二海郡八雲町
sales_point: 雄鉾岳の山裾、見市川土井に位置する温泉地。幕末から利用されてきた温泉で歴史が永い。浴槽から渓流のせせらぎを聞くことができ、静かな環境にある。上流には紅葉の名所として知られる雲石峡がある。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers an exceptional abalone full-course meal, with many preparations like sashimi and steak, and a unique iron-rich hot spring with a perfectly warm outdoor bath. They also highlight the attentive staff and the tranquil atmosphere with river views.

Some reviews mention the facilities can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located at the foot of Mount Ouhoko, along the Miichi River. It has a long history of use since the late Edo period, and you can hear the sound of the stream from the bath, in a quiet environment. The upstream area is known for its beautiful autumn leaves at Unseikyo.

name: 剣淵温泉
location: 北海道 上川郡剣淵町
sales_point: 剣淵町の西端の桜岡湖畔にある温泉地。桜岡公園の大自然に囲まれた環境にあり、桜岡湖を一望できる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located on the shores of Lake Sakurako at the western edge of Tsurubuchi Town, surrounded by the great nature of Sakurako Park, offering a view of the lake.

name: 原生亭温泉
location: 北海道 斜里郡小清水町
sales_point: 小清水町の西北、オホーツク海と濤沸湖に挟まれたところにある温泉地。景色がとても良い。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a rich, dark brown "moor" hot spring with a smooth texture and high water temperature, which effectively warms the body and leaves skin feeling smooth. They also highlight the affordable 400 yen entry fee, making it a great value. Visitors appreciate the friendly atmosphere, with locals often striking up conversations.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the northwest of Koshimizu Town, nestled between the Sea of Okhotsk and Lake Tohubutsu. The scenery is very beautiful.

name: 高原温泉
location: 北海道 上川郡上川町
sales_point: 標高1300メートルに位置する温泉地。ヤンベタップ川沿いにあり豊かな泉源を持つ秘湯。夏期だけの営業となる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located at an elevation of 1300 meters, along the Yanbetappu River, known for its rich hot spring sources. It operates only during the summer.

name: 向陽温泉
location: 北海道 深川市
sales_point: 国道12号線沿いに位置する温泉地。10数種類の漢方薬草を利用した薬湯が好評。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located along National Route 12, popular for its medicinal baths made from a variety of herbal medicines.

name: 小金湯温泉
location: 北海道 札幌市
sales_point: 札幌の南西、定山渓温泉の東5キロ程に位置する温泉地。大自然に囲まれた閑静な温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located southwest of Sapporo, about 5 kilometers east of Jozankei Onsen, in a quiet area surrounded by nature.

name: 小清水温泉
location: 北海道 斜里郡小清水町
sales_point: 小清水町のほぼ中心部に位置する温泉地。道東観光の拠点となっている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located almost in the center of Koshimizu Town, serving as a base for sightseeing in Eastern Hokkaido.

name: 虎杖浜温泉
location: 北海道 白老郡白老町
sales_point: 太平洋を望む国道36号線沿いに位置する温泉地。虎杖浜地区から竹浦地区にかけて広がる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located along National Route 36, overlooking the Pacific Ocean, stretching from the Kotohira area to the Takeura area.

name: 古丹別温泉
location: 北海道 苫前郡苫前町
sales_point: 苫前町役場の南東、古丹別に位置する温泉地。すぐ近くに桜の名所で知られる緑ヶ丘公園がある。町民の交流の場としても利用されており、日帰り入浴もできる。海の幸やジンギスカンが人気。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious local seafood dishes like octopus shabu-shabu and sweet shrimp, along with a variety of other tasty meals. They also highlight the beautiful ocean views from the outdoor baths and the reasonable prices.

Other reviews mention the staff can be unhelpful.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located southeast of Tomamae Town Hall, in Kodambetsu. Close to Midorigaoka Park, known for its cherry blossoms. It is also used as a community space for residents, with day-use bathing available. Seafood and Genghis Khan are popular.

name: 駒ケ岳温泉
location: 北海道 茅部郡森町
sales_point: 駒ヶ岳を間近に眺望できる温泉地。大沼公園もすぐ近くにあり、函館からも近く、観光の拠点に好適。
review_summary: Guests mention this hot spring inn offers delicious regional cuisine, including kiritanpo hot pot and handmade soba, and features spacious, atmospheric indoor and open-air baths. They also highlight the free shuttle service to Tsuru-no-Yu Onsen, allowing evening visits. Visitors appreciate the reasonable prices for the quality of the food and the relaxing, quiet natural setting.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area with a close view of Mount Komagatake. Located near Onuma Park, it serves as a great base for sightseeing from Hakodate.

name: 昆布川(ニセコ温泉郷）
location: 北海道 磯谷郡蘭越町
sales_point: 昆布駅近くに位置する温泉地。湯は重曹を含み、美肌効果が高いと言われている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near Konbu Station. The water contains bicarbonate, known for its high skin beautifying effects.

name: 五色(ニセコ温泉郷）
location: 北海道 磯谷郡蘭越町
sales_point: ニセコアンヌプリとイワオヌプリのはざまの谷間に位置する温泉地。標高750メートルの高原にあり自然環境が良い。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: People say this hot spring offers excellent quality, naturally flowing spring water that warms the body deeply and leaves skin smooth. They also highlight the beautiful outdoor baths with stunning mountain views, especially enjoyable during snowy seasons. Guests mention the reasonable price for the experience and the quiet, relaxing atmosphere.
sales_point_en: Situated in a valley between Mount Niseko Annupuri and Mount Iwaonupuri, this hot spring area is at an elevation of 750 meters, surrounded by a beautiful natural environment. It is a designated national health resort.

name: 五味温泉
location: 北海道 上川郡下川町
sales_point: 周囲を豊かな緑に囲まれた山間に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にある。炭酸を含んだ泉質が心と体を温める。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a rare carbonated spring with excellent water quality, and many highlight the effective sauna and refreshing cold plunge pool. They also mention the reasonable 500 yen admission fee for day visitors and the clean, well-maintained facilities. Guests appreciate the friendly and attentive staff, noting the delicious local udon and eggs available.
sales_point_en: Nestled in the mountains surrounded by rich greenery, this hot spring area offers a tranquil environment. The carbonated water warms both the mind and body.

name: 盃温泉
location: 北海道 古宇郡泊村
sales_point: 積丹半島南側基部に位置する温泉地。ニセコ積丹小樽海岸国定公園内にあり、自然環境に恵まれている。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious meals, especially the generous sashimi boat, and features spacious rooms with ocean views from the balcony and open-air baths. They also highlight the reasonable prices for a two-meal plan and the availability of laundry facilities.

Other reviews mention the outdoor bath can be cold.
sales_point_en: Located at the base of the Shakotan Peninsula, this hot spring area is within the Niseko Shakotan Otaru Coast National Park, blessed with a beautiful natural environment. It is a designated national health resort.

name: 桜野温泉
location: 北海道 二海郡八雲町
sales_point: 野田追川沿いの山あいに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で釣り・登山なども楽しめる。せせらぎの音で心が洗われる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains along the Nodaoi River. It offers a quiet environment where you can enjoy fishing and hiking, with the soothing sound of flowing water.

name: 沙流川温泉
location: 北海道 沙流郡日高町
sales_point: 日高山脈の山裾町、日高町のほぼ中心部に位置する温泉地。スキー場、キャンプ場が隣接している。
sales_point_en: Located at the foot of the Hidaka Mountains, this hot spring area is almost in the center of Hidaka Town, adjacent to ski resorts and campgrounds.

name: 砂原温泉
location: 北海道 茅部郡森町
sales_point: 秀峰駒ヶ岳を背にエメラルドに輝く噴火湾を望む、風光明媚な環境にある温泉地。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen features a variety of baths with different temperatures, including a hot outdoor bath, and highlight the high-quality spring water that leaves skin feeling moisturized. They also appreciate the quiet, uncrowded atmosphere and the convenient self-service system.

Some reviews mention the bathing area can be small.
sales_point_en: A picturesque hot spring area overlooking the emerald waters of Funka Bay, backed by the majestic Mount Komagatake.

name: 塩狩温泉
location: 北海道 上川郡和寒町
sales_point: 和寒町の東南、塩狩峰の山麓に位置する温泉地。白樺林に包まれた閑静な環境。周辺の丘陵部は山菜が豊富。
sales_point_en: Located southeast of Wakkanai Town at the foot of Mount Shiozuri, this hot spring area is surrounded by white birch forests in a tranquil environment, with abundant wild vegetables in the nearby hills.

name: 鹿部温泉
location: 北海道 茅部郡鹿部町
sales_point: 噴火湾を臨む海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。湯量豊富で、間歇泉もある。平成11年春、「しかべ間歇泉公園」がオープン。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the coast overlooking Funka Bay. It has abundant hot water and features a geyser. The 'Shikabe Geyser Park' opened in spring 1999.

name: 然別峡かんの温泉
location: 北海道 河東郡鹿追町
sales_point: 大雪山国立公園の東南にあるウペペサンケ山の南側山麓に位置する温泉地。シイシカリベツ川上流の大自然に囲まれ、豊富な湯量を誇る。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features 13 different natural hot spring sources and 11 baths, including rare foot-level gushing springs, with varying temperatures and mineral compositions that leave skin smooth. They also highlight the clean, spacious rooms and the delicious, well-balanced traditional Japanese meals. Guests mention the staff are friendly and helpful, and the remote, quiet location offers a unique, authentic experience.
sales_point_en: Located at the southern foot of Mount Uppepesanke in the southeastern part of Daisetsuzan National Park, this hot spring area is surrounded by nature along the upper reaches of the Shishikaribetsu River, boasting abundant hot water. It is a designated national health resort.

name: 然別湖畔温泉
location: 北海道 河東郡鹿追町
sales_point: 大雪山国立公園の南にある然別湖南西岸に位置する温泉地。自然景観が良く閑静な環境にある。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers stunning lake views from rooms and the open-air bath, along with delicious, generous meals featuring local ingredients like *oshokoma* fish. Guests also highlight the excellent hot spring quality, quiet atmosphere, and helpful staff.

Some reviews mention the rooms can be neglected.
sales_point_en: Situated on the southwestern shore of Lake Shakotan, south of Daisetsuzan National Park, this hot spring area offers beautiful natural scenery and a quiet environment.

name: 支笏湖温泉
location: 北海道 千歳市
sales_point: 支笏湖の東北側に位置する温泉地。紋別岳の南側山麓にあり、支笏湖で釣りやボートなどが楽しめる秘湯。
sales_point_en: Located on the northeastern side of Lake Shikotsu, this hot spring area is at the southern foot of Mount Monbetsu, offering a hidden hot spring experience with fishing and boating opportunities on Lake Shikotsu.

name: 静内温泉
location: 北海道 日高郡新ひだか町
sales_point: 種馬の放牧で知られる静内町の浦和地区に位置する温泉地。静内の海岸に近く、潮干狩りなども楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features multiple baths with varying temperatures, a sauna with a TV, and a spacious, clean facility with a wide selection of food. They also highlight the affordable entry fee, free sauna mat rentals, and the relaxing outdoor air-bathing area.

Some reviews mention the washing areas can be reserved.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the Urawa district of Shizunai Town, known for its breeding of stallions. Close to the Shizunai coast, it also offers clam digging and other activities.

name: 志文町温泉
location: 北海道 岩見沢市
sales_point: 岩見沢市街地南方、国道沿いに位置する温泉地。源泉を一切ろ過していない。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a wide variety of baths, including spacious outdoor tubs, and two types of saunas. They also highlight the affordable 500 yen entrance fee and the value of the meal and bath set.

Other reviews mention the staff can be impolite.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located south of Iwamizawa city center along the national highway. The source water is not filtered at all.

name: 標茶温泉
location: 北海道 川上郡標茶町
sales_point: 釧路湿原国立公園の最北端に位置する温泉地。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a rich, amber-colored moor spring with a smooth, slippery texture, and two indoor baths with different temperatures. Visitors also highlight the well-maintained facilities, despite their age, and the reasonable 600 yen entry fee. They also appreciate the availability of solid soap and the convenient parking.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the northernmost point of Kushiro Wetland National Park.

name: 標津温泉
location: 北海道 標津郡標津町
sales_point: 知床半島への玄関口、標津町の市街地にある温泉地。湯量豊富。
review_summary: People say this natural hot spring offers a free, high-quality, milky white sulfur spring with a strong sulfur scent. Visitors also highlight the separate changing rooms and concrete tubs for each gender, which are rare for a wild hot spring. They also mention the ability to adjust the water temperature using a hose.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the city center of Shibetsu Town, the gateway to the Shiretoko Peninsula, with abundant hot water.

name: 島の下温泉
location: 北海道 富良野市
sales_point: ラベンダーの森の中に位置する温泉地。ＪＲ富良野から約7キロにあり、スキー場やゴルフ場も近い。7月～8月上旬は一面ラベンダー色に染まる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including open-air options with mountain views, and features clean, well-maintained facilities. They also highlight the kind staff, delicious food, and reasonable prices for day-use bathing.

Other reviews mention the service can be impolite.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a lavender forest, about 7 kilometers from JR Furano Station, with nearby ski resorts and golf courses. In July to early August, the area is covered in lavender blooms.

name: 清水温泉
location: 北海道 上川郡清水町
sales_point: 清水町北東部の北熊牛地区に位置する温泉地。日高山脈と十勝平野を眺望する高台に町営施設があり、コテージ８棟と入浴施設がある。日帰りの利用も可能。
sales_point_en: Located in the northeastern part of Shimizu Town, in the Kitakumaushi district, this hot spring area features a town-operated facility on a hill overlooking the Hidaka Mountains and Tokachi Plain, with eight cottages and bathing facilities available for day use.

name: 下居辺温泉
location: 北海道 河東郡士幌町
sales_point: 士幌町東部の居辺川の清流沿いに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にある。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers spacious, clean rooms and delicious meals, especially the local "Shihoro beef" dishes. They also highlight the all-inclusive drink plan, the quality of the "moor hot spring" baths, and the friendly, attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the park golf course can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the clear stream of the Ioribe River in the eastern part of Shihoro Town, offering a quiet environment.

name: しゃこたん温泉
location: 北海道 積丹郡積丹町
sales_point: 積丹岬と神威岬のある美しい自然に恵まれた積丹町に位置する温泉地。夏は海水浴や水中展望船で美しい海を楽しむ人々で賑わう。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen offers spectacular ocean views from its outdoor baths, especially at sunset, and features a wide variety of modern facilities, including a sauna and cold plunge pool. They also highlight the clean and well-maintained premises, as well as the availability of local products and diverse food options. Guests mention the facility is tattoo-friendly and provides a relaxing atmosphere for unwinding.
sales_point_en: Located in the beautiful natural surroundings of Shakotan Town, which features Shakotan Cape and Kamoi Cape. In summer, the area is bustling with people enjoying the beautiful sea through swimming and underwater sightseeing boats.

name: 斜里温泉
location: 北海道 斜里郡斜里町
sales_point: 斜里町の市街地に位置する温泉地。温泉街は形成されていないが、旅館や民宿で温泉が利用されている。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring inn offers excellent quality "moor" spring water, with some rooms featuring private, free-flowing baths. They also highlight the affordable prices for day-use bathing and the helpful, friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the hot spring water can be scalding.
sales_point_en: An onsen located in the urban area of Shari Town. Although there is no developed onsen town, ryokans and minpaku (guesthouses) offer onsen facilities.

name: 白老温泉
location: 北海道 白老郡白老町
sales_point: 白老地区から北吉原地区に広がる温泉地。ポトコタンにも近い。
sales_point_en: An onsen area that extends from the Shiraoi district to the Kitayoshihara district. It is also close to Potokotan.

name: 白滝温泉
location: 北海道 紋別郡遠軽町
sales_point: 漁別川の河畔、白滝駅の西1500ﾒｰﾄﾙの所に位置する温泉地。周囲を深い針葉樹林におおわれている。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a small but clean indoor bath, an open-air bath, and a unique wood-fired sauna. Guests also highlight the smooth, alkaline spring water and the reasonable 600 yen entry fee.

Some reviews mention the changing room can be small.
sales_point_en: Located 1500 meters west of Shirataki Station along the banks of the Gyobetsu River, this onsen is surrounded by deep coniferous forests.

name: 白金温泉
location: 北海道 上川郡美瑛町
sales_point: 十勝岳の北側山麓に位置する温泉地。美瑛川上流の渓谷沿いで自然環境に恵まれている。十勝岳の展望がよい。
sales_point_en: Situated at the foothills on the north side of Tokachidake, this onsen is blessed with a natural environment along the upstream valley of the Biei River, offering great views of Tokachidake.

name: しんしのつ温泉
location: 北海道 石狩郡新篠津村
sales_point: しのつ湖畔に位置する温泉地。道の駅「しんしのつ」を併設し、石狩川河川敷ではゴルフやグランピングなどのアクティビティーを楽しめる。冬はしのつ湖にて、「ワカサギ釣り」で賑わう。「ジェラート」が名物。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers excellent quality hot spring water, including a spacious open-air bath, and a wide variety of delicious breakfast buffet options. They also highlight the friendly and helpful staff, and the convenient, ample parking.

Other reviews mention the wakasagi fishing can be expensive.
sales_point_en: Located by the shores of Lake Shinotsu, this onsen features a roadside station 'Shinshinotsu' and offers activities like golf and glamping along the Ishikari River. In winter, it is popular for 'Wakasagi fishing'. The gelato is a local specialty.

name: 新得温泉
location: 北海道 上川郡新得町
sales_point: 市街の南方2キロ、佐幌川の清流と町並みを見下ろす高台にある温泉地。日高山系の山並みを一望できる。自然に囲まれた閑静な環境にある。
sales_point_en: Located on a hill overlooking the clear stream of the Saporo River and the town, just 2 kilometers south of the city center. It offers a tranquil environment surrounded by nature with a panoramic view of the Hidaka mountain range.

name: 新富町温泉
location: 北海道 釧路市
sales_point: 釧路市中心部の釧路駅より徒歩10分という便利な場所に位置する温泉地。民宿大喜館の浴場使用と宿泊も可能。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers spacious indoor and outdoor baths, a large sauna, and a refreshing cold mint bath. They also highlight the affordable 500 yen entry fee and the delicious, reasonably priced restaurant options.

Some reviews mention the atmosphere can be noisy.
sales_point_en: Conveniently located just a 10-minute walk from Kushiro Station in the city center, this onsen allows for the use of the bath and accommodation at the Minpaku Daikikan.

name: 新町温泉
location: 北海道 空知郡上富良野町
sales_point: 上富良野の市街地に位置する温泉地。駅から徒歩で約10分の好立地。
sales_point_en: An onsen located in the urban area of Kamifurano, just about a 10-minute walk from the station.

name: 定山渓温泉
location: 北海道 札幌市
sales_point: 札幌市の南西、豊平川上流河畔に位置する温泉地。数多くの施設が渓谷沿いに点在し、大温泉地を形成している。
sales_point_en: Located upstream along the Toyohira River in the southwest of Sapporo City, this onsen area is dotted with numerous facilities along the valley, forming a large onsen resort.

name: 砂浜温泉
location: 北海道 岩見沢市
sales_point: 北村の北端にある旧石狩川の河畔に位置する温泉地。景観は最高で旧石狩川を一望できる。
sales_point_en: Situated at the northern end of Kitamura along the banks of the old Ishikari River, this onsen offers stunning views of the old Ishikari River.

name: 瀬戸瀬温泉
location: 北海道 紋別郡遠軽町
sales_point: 瀬戸瀬山の山麓に位置する温泉地。周囲を針葉樹林に囲まれている。飲泉もでき、コーヒーやお茶をいれるとおいしいと評判。
sales_point_en: Located at the foothills of Setose Mountain, this onsen is surrounded by coniferous forests. It is known for its drinkable water, which is reputed to make delicious coffee and tea.

name: 層雲峡温泉
location: 北海道 上川郡上川町
sales_point: 層雲峡の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。道央最大の温泉地で、大雪山・層雲峡観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: Located along the Sounkyo Gorge, this onsen is the largest in the Doto region and serves as a great base for sightseeing in Daisetsuzan and Sounkyo.

name: 総進温泉
location: 北海道 樺戸郡新十津川町
sales_point: 運動や体験の施設が豊富な「ふるさと公園」があり、温泉や料理以外にも存分に楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers three different temperature baths, a sauna, and a cold plunge, with abundant hot spring water that warms the body. They also highlight the delicious and varied local cuisine, including Jingisukan and sake kasu zangi, and the friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the air conditioning can be insufficient.
sales_point_en: Home to the 'Furusato Park' with abundant sports and experiential facilities, this onsen offers plenty of enjoyment beyond just hot springs and cuisine.

name: 壮瞥温泉
location: 北海道 有珠郡壮瞥町
sales_point: 洞爺湖の南岸に位置する温泉地。正面に洞爺湖、背後に有珠山や昭和新山を望む。風光明媚な環境にある。
sales_point_en: Located on the southern shore of Lake Toya, this onsen offers views of Lake Toya in front and Mount Usu and Showa Shinzan behind, set in a picturesque environment.

name: 高松温泉
location: 北海道 夕張市
sales_point: 夕張市の中心地内に位置する温泉地。本格的シティホテルで温泉を楽しむことができる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a unique coffee-colored "moor" spring that leaves skin feeling smooth and moisturized, along with spacious bathing areas and a hot sauna. They also highlight the friendly staff, comfortable rest areas, and delicious food options.

Some reviews mention the bathing areas can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: Located in the center of Yubari City, this onsen allows guests to enjoy hot springs in a full-fledged city hotel.

name: 滝の湯温泉
location: 北海道 北見市
sales_point: 国道39号線沿いに位置する温泉地。肌がつるつるする泉質で、低料金の公共の宿がある。観光シーズンは若者にも人気。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features a unique, slippery hot spring water that leaves skin feeling smooth and soft. They also highlight its convenient 24-hour, unmanned operation, allowing access at any time. Guests mention the reasonable 500 yen entry fee and the availability of body soap and shampoo.
sales_point_en: Situated along National Route 39, this onsen features a skin-smoothening water quality and offers affordable public accommodations. It is popular among young people during the tourist season.

name: 竹山高原温泉
location: 北海道 北広島市
sales_point: 大自然に抱かれ、遠くは樽前等の連峰が一望できる温泉地。600tの道内銘石を使用した露天岩風呂が名物。
sales_point_en: Nestled in nature, this onsen offers a panoramic view of distant mountains like Tarumae. The outdoor rock bath made from 600 tons of local stone is a highlight.

name: 龍之湯温泉
location: 北海道 旭川市
sales_point: ＪＲ東旭川の南方の田園地帯に位置する温泉地。旭川公園の動物園に近い。近郊の人々の保養所として親しまれている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has a unique, rust-colored iron-rich spring water that is very warming and leaves skin feeling moisturized. They also highlight the reasonable entry fee and the clean, well-maintained facilities.

Other reviews mention the single dryer can be inconvenient.
sales_point_en: Located in the rural area south of JR Higashi-Asahikawa, this onsen is close to the zoo in Asahikawa Park and is cherished as a health resort by local residents.

name: 館浦温泉
location: 北海道 爾志郡乙部町
sales_point: 国道229号線沿いに位置する温泉地。ヤチダモ林に囲まれ閑静な環境にある。色白でスリムになると評判の温泉。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has a smooth, skin-beautifying hot spring bath, a spacious indoor bath, and a sauna with a cold plunge pool. Guests also highlight the reasonable 400 yen entry fee, the complimentary post-bath ice cream, and the spotless facilities.

Some reviews mention shampoo can be not provided.
sales_point_en: Situated along National Route 229, this onsen is surrounded by a Yachidamo forest in a quiet environment. It is reputed for its skin-whitening and slimming effects.

name: 丹頂の里温泉
location: 北海道 釧路市
sales_point: 阿寒市街北方に位置する温泉地。周囲には自然休養村やツルの博物館、道の駅等がある。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring facility offers excellent quality hot spring water, with some noting its unique brown color and skin-smoothing properties. They also highlight the reasonable prices for day use and the friendly, helpful staff.

Other reviews mention the facility can be overly warm.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located north of Akanko city, surrounded by a natural recreation village, a crane museum, and a roadside station.

name: 伊達温泉
location: 北海道 伊達市
sales_point: 伊達市西部を流れる長流川近くに位置し、周囲を畑に囲まれた温泉地。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers a soft, clear, and warming onsen experience, with a variety of baths including hot, lukewarm, and open-air options. Guests also highlight the delicious food, especially the Genghis Khan and fried octopus, and appreciate the reasonable prices for both day-use and overnight stays.

Other reviews mention the facility can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the Nagauragawa River in the western part of Date City, surrounded by fields.

name: 秩父別温泉
location: 北海道 雨竜郡秩父別町
sales_point: 秩父別の市街に位置する温泉地。広大な田園風景の中にある。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a wide variety of baths, including indoor, outdoor, jacuzzi, and sauna, with some featuring unique "silky" or "golden" waters. They also highlight the affordable 500-yen entrance fee, the delicious and plentiful meals, and the generally clean and well-maintained facilities.

Some reviews mention the service can be inconsistent.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the town center of Chichibubetsu, amidst vast rural landscapes.

name: 千走川温泉
location: 北海道 島牧郡島牧村
sales_point: 千走川沿いの山峡に位置する温泉地。山に囲まれた静かな環境にある。露天風呂有り。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a mountain gorge along the Chisokugawa River, surrounded by mountains in a quiet environment. Features an outdoor bath.

name: 中央温泉
location: 北海道 札幌市
sales_point: 札幌市中心部の市街地内に位置する温泉地。アーバンリゾートホテルと天然温泉の組み合わせが人気。
review_summary:
People say this natural hot spring offers a wide variety of baths, including spacious indoor and outdoor options, plus a salt sauna and a regular sauna. They also highlight the affordable 500 yen entry fee, the convenient 4-hour free parking, and the friendly staff.

Other reviews mention it can be extremely crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the city center of Sapporo, popular for its combination of urban resort hotel and natural hot springs.

name: チロルの湯温泉
location: 北海道 歌志内市
sales_point: 歌志内市の西部の道の駅内に位置する温泉。四季折々に美しい大自然の懐にあり、美肌の湯として評判。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including main, jet, and "tsubo" (pot) baths, along with a sauna and spacious outdoor rotenburo. They also highlight the reasonable 500 yen entry fee, strong shower pressure, and relaxing atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the facility can be crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located within a roadside station in the western part of Utashinai City, surrounded by beautiful nature throughout the seasons, known for its skin-beautifying properties.

name: 月形温泉
location: 北海道 樺戸郡月形町
sales_point: 国道275号線沿い、皆楽公園の一角に位置する温泉地。入浴すると肌がすべすべし、美肌効果が高いと言われている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 275, in a corner of Minarai Park. It is said to have skin-smoothing effects.

name: 鶴居温泉
location: 北海道 阿寒郡鶴居村
sales_point: 「タンチョウヅルの舞う湯の里」として知られる鶴居村に位置する温泉地。冬場はタンチョウヅルが集まり、観光客で賑わう。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area known as 'the hot spring village where the Japanese cranes dance,' located in Tsurui Village, which attracts tourists in winter when cranes gather.

name: 鶴の湯温泉
location: 北海道 勇払郡安平町
sales_point: 早来町郊外、安平川近くに涌く温泉。閑静で大自然が四季折々に美しい。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a unique sulfur-scented, brownish hot spring that leaves skin smooth, and many enjoy the spacious, clean bathing area. They also highlight the delicious fried chicken and sauced fried noodles at the restaurant, and the well-maintained lotus pond with carp.

Some reviews mention there can be a lack of amenities.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located near the Abira River on the outskirts of Hayakawa Town, in a quiet area with beautiful nature throughout the seasons.

name: 天塩川温泉
location: 北海道 中川郡音威子府村
sales_point: 天塩川沿いに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養に好適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring inn offers a wide variety of delicious dishes, including crispy tempura and the unique black Otoineppu soba, and features spacious, well-maintained rooms. They also highlight the smooth, skin-softening hot spring water, the friendly staff, and the reasonable prices.

Some reviews mention the white rice can be dry.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Teshio River, in a quiet environment, suitable for relaxation.

name: 天人峡温泉
location: 北海道 上川郡東川町
sales_point: 大雪山の東側山麓に位置する温泉地。天人峡と呼ばれる景勝地にあり、羽衣ノ滝や敷島の滝などの見所も近い。登山のベースにも好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of the eastern side of Daisetsuzan, near scenic spots like Tenninkyo and Hakugai Falls, ideal for mountain climbing.

name: 鐺別温泉
location: 北海道 川上郡弟子屈町
sales_point: 弟子屈の郊外、鐺別川河畔に位置する温泉地。森に囲まれた閑静な環境にあり、桜の名所としても知られている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the Kangabetsu River on the outskirts of Teshikaga, surrounded by forests in a quiet environment, also known for its cherry blossom spots.

name: 洞爺湖温泉
location: 北海道 虻田郡洞爺湖町
sales_point: 洞爺湖の南岸に位置する温泉地。風光明媚な環境にあり、自然景観が良い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the southern shore of Lake Toya, in a picturesque environment with beautiful natural scenery.

name: 洞爺・陽だまり温泉
location: 北海道 虻田郡洞爺湖町
sales_point: 洞爺湖の北側湖畔に位置する温泉地。一帯が「支笏洞爺国立公園」に指定され、風光明媚な環境にある。道央観光はもちろん、国民保養温泉地に指定され、保養・療養にも好適。100リットル/50円の温泉スタンドも好評。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the northern lakeside of Lake Toya, designated as part of Shikotsu-Toya National Park, in a scenic environment. It is suitable for relaxation and therapy, with a popular hot spring stand offering 100 liters for 50 yen.

name: 十勝川温泉
location: 北海道 河東郡音更町
sales_point: 広大な十勝平野の中を流れる十勝川沿いに位置する温泉地。泉質は単純温泉だが「モール泉」と呼ばれる植物性の成分が含まれているのが特徴。道央観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Tokachi River flowing through the vast Tokachi Plain. Although the water quality is simple, it contains plant-based components known as 'mole spring.' Ideal as a base for central Hokkaido tourism.

name: 十勝岳温泉
location: 北海道 空知郡上富良野町
sales_point: 北海道の中央部、大雪山国立公園内に位置する高原の温泉地。自然環境に恵まれ、保養・登山に好適。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: A highland hot spring area located in the central part of Hokkaido, within Daisetsuzan National Park. Blessed with a natural environment, it is suitable for relaxation and mountain climbing, designated as a national health resort.

name: トムラウシ温泉
location: 北海道 上川郡新得町
sales_point: 大雪山国立公園の東側、トムラウシ川の河畔の原始林に囲まれて湧く温泉。神秘的な秘境の温泉地。
review_summary: Guests mention this onsen hotel features spacious and clean facilities, including multiple indoor and outdoor baths with varying temperatures, a hot steam sauna, and a cold plunge. They also highlight the delicious and satisfying meals, often featuring local ingredients like sika deer, and the attentive, friendly staff. Visitors appreciate the tranquil atmosphere and the stunning views of the river and surrounding nature from the open-air baths.
sales_point_en: A hot spring surrounded by primitive forests along the Tomuraushi River on the eastern side of Daisetsuzan National Park. A mystical hidden hot spring area.

name: 豊富温泉
location: 北海道 天塩郡豊富町
sales_point: 豊富町の市街地より東方6キロに位置する温泉地。台地にあり遙かに利尻冨士を望み、眼下には放牧風景が展望できる。保養・休養に好適な国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located 6 kilometers east of the city center of Toyotomi Town, on a plateau with a distant view of Rishiri Fuji and a scenic view of grazing landscapes below. Suitable for relaxation and recuperation, designated as a national health resort.

name: 奈井江温泉
location: 北海道 空知郡奈井江町
sales_point: 豊かな自然に囲まれた環境の良い温泉地。温泉につかりながら、四季折々の美しい風景を楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area in a good environment surrounded by rich nature, where visitors can enjoy beautiful seasonal landscapes while soaking in the hot spring.

name: ナイタイ高原温泉
location: 北海道 河東郡上士幌町
sales_point: ナイタイ高原に位置する山あいの温泉地。ナイタイ高原牧場が近く、自然環境が良い。
sales_point_en: A mountain hot spring area located in Naitai Kogen, near Naitai Kogen Ranch, with a good natural environment.

name: ナウマン温泉
location: 北海道 中川郡幕別町
sales_point: ナウマン象発掘の地で知られる忠類村に位置する温泉地。白銀台スキー場やナウマン象記念館などの観光施設が近い。
review_summary:
People say this hotel's hot springs have a wonderful, thick, and smooth texture, and they appreciate the clean and well-maintained facilities, including saunas and various baths. Guests also highlight the delicious food, reasonable prices, and the friendly, attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the rooms can be cold.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in Churui Village, known for the excavation site of the Naumann elephant. Close to tourist facilities such as the Shirogane Ski Resort and the Naumann Elephant Memorial Museum.

name: 中小屋温泉
location: 北海道 石狩郡当別町
sales_point: 当別町営スキー場近くの山間に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境の一軒宿。露天の岩風呂がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains near the Tobetsu Town ski resort. A quiet inn in a serene environment, featuring an outdoor rock bath.

name: 中標津温泉
location: 北海道 標津郡中標津町
sales_point: 中標津市街に点在する温泉地。シティホテルタイプ、ライダーハウスなど様々ある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area scattered throughout Nakashibetsu city. Offers various accommodations including city hotel types and rider houses.

name: なかふらの温泉
location: 北海道 空知郡中富良野町
spa_quality: ナトリウム・カルシウム－塩化物泉
sales_point: 北海道の中央部に位置し、中富良野町の田園地帯に佇む、町唯一の温泉地。雄大な十勝岳連峰全景を一望できるロケーション。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a wide variety of baths, including jet baths, pot baths, and a cave bath, with many appreciating the open-air bath that provides views of the Tokachi mountain range. Guests also highlight the spacious parking and the option for cashless payments.

Other reviews mention the baths can be poorly maintained.
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム－塩化物泉
sales_point_en: The only hot spring area in Nakafurano Town, located in the rural landscape of central Hokkaido. Offers a magnificent view of the entire Tokachi mountain range.

name: ながぬま温泉
location: 北海道 夕張郡長沼町
sales_point: 石狩平野を見下ろす小高い台地に位置する温泉地。牧場や山林の広大な景観が楽しめる。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a wide variety of baths, including open-air and jacuzzi options, with many being free-flowing and featuring different temperatures. They also highlight the spacious and warm resting areas, delicious soft-serve ice cream, and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the facility can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a small hill overlooking the Ishikari Plain. Enjoy vast landscapes of ranches and forests. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 七重浜温泉
location: 北海道 北斗市
sales_point: 函館市郊外の上磯町に位置する温泉地。国道228号線沿いにあり、七重浜海水浴場は目の前という立地条件の恵まれた所。プールやサウナ等も併設されている。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring facility offers a wide variety of baths, including two types of natural hot springs, multiple indoor and outdoor tubs, and both high- and low-temperature saunas. They also highlight the spacious and clean facilities, reasonable prices, and convenient long operating hours.

Some reviews mention the facilities can be out of order.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in Kamiso Town, just outside Hakodate City. Conveniently situated along National Route 228, with Nanaehama Beach right in front. Also features a pool and sauna.

name: 名寄温泉
location: 北海道 名寄市
sales_point: 市内の北東部のピヤシリスキー場にある温泉地。ピヤシリの壮大な自然と冬に出現するサンピラーが神秘的。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers delicious meals, including local pork and "jingisukan," and features a clean, spacious bathing area with a large sauna and natural hot spring. Guests also highlight the friendly staff, reasonable prices, and convenient access to the ski resort.

Other reviews mention the sauna can be too hot.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the Piyashiri Ski Resort in the northeastern part of the city. The majestic nature of Piyashiri and the mysterious sun pillars that appear in winter are highlights.

name: 南幌温泉
location: 北海道 空知郡南幌町
sales_point: 近年、札幌のベッドタウンとして発展してきた南幌町に位置する温泉地。町営の温泉利用施設で日帰り入浴も楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility, recently renovated, offers a clean environment with a variety of baths, including a spacious open-air bath and a highly-rated sauna with auto-löyly. They also highlight the delicious and generously portioned "cabbage tempura rice bowl" and the reasonable admission fees.

Other reviews mention the staff can be impolite.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in Minporo Town, which has recently developed as a bedroom community for Sapporo. A municipal hot spring facility where day-use bathing is also available.

name: 新見温泉(ニセコ温泉郷）
location: 北海道 磯谷郡蘭越町
sales_point: 奥新見渓谷上流の山間に位置する温泉地。周辺にはいくつもの神秘的な滝がある。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: Guests mention this onsen hotel offers spacious, clean rooms and a wonderful outdoor onsen, perfect for soaking after skiing. They also highlight the delicious kaiseki dinners and breakfast buffets, along with the friendly and professional staff. Visitors appreciate the excellent value for money and the convenient, short walk to the Annupuri ski slopes.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains upstream of the Oku Niimi Valley. Surrounded by several mysterious waterfalls. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 濁川温泉
location: 北海道 茅部郡森町
sales_point: のどかな田園地帯の中に位置する温泉地。５種類の泉質の異なる源泉がある。保養・療養に好適。
review_summary: People say this onsen has unique spring water and multiple baths with varying temperatures, which visitors can adjust themselves. They also highlight the historic, retro building and the warm, friendly atmosphere. Guests mention the facility is well-maintained and clean, despite its age.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a tranquil rural setting. Features five different types of spring sources. Ideal for relaxation and therapy.

name: ２１世紀森の湯温泉
location: 北海道 旭川市
sales_point: 米飯川上流河畔のキャンプ場内に位置する温泉地。家族連れや若者達が訪れ、賑わいを見せている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located within a campground along the upper reaches of the Komebana River. Popular among families and young people.

name: ニセコアンヌプリ温泉
location: 北海道 虻田郡ニセコ町
sales_point: ニセコアンヌプリの南側山麓に位置する温泉地。アンヌプリスキー場とモイワスキー場の間に湧く温泉。
review_summary:
Guests mention this onsen features a spacious and relaxing outdoor rock bath, along with clean and well-maintained indoor facilities. They also highlight the delicious meals, comfortable rooms, and the availability of free massage chairs.

Other reviews mention the onsen can be expensive.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the southern foot of Mount Niseko Annupuri. The hot spring springs between Annupuri Ski Resort and Moiwa Ski Resort.

name: ニセコ昆布温泉(ニセコ温泉郷）
location: 北海道 磯谷郡蘭越町
sales_point: ニセコアンヌプリの西南側山あいに位置する温泉地。隣接するニセコ町にまたがるニセコ最大の温泉郷。四季折々の自然にふれ、浴衣掛けで温泉街のそぞろ歩きを楽しめる。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: Guests mention this hotel offers spacious rooms with private onsen baths, providing a tranquil and relaxing atmosphere. They also highlight the delicious and fresh meals, with many appreciating the variety of vegetable dishes and complimentary drinks in the lounge. Visitors consistently praise the attentive and professional staff, noting their exceptional hospitality and helpfulness.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the southwestern mountains of Niseko Annupuri. The largest hot spring area in Niseko, spanning across the adjacent Niseko Town. Experience nature in all four seasons and enjoy strolling through the hot spring town in a yukata. Designated as a national health resort.

name: ニセコ昆布(ニセコ温泉郷）
location: 北海道 虻田郡ニセコ町
sales_point: ニセコアンヌプリの西南側山あいに位置する温泉地。隣接する蘭越町にまたがるニセコ最大の温泉郷。四季折々の自然にふれ、浴衣掛けで温泉街のそぞろ歩きを楽しめる。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: Guests mention this hotel offers spacious rooms with private onsen baths, providing a tranquil and relaxing atmosphere. They also highlight the delicious and fresh meals, with many appreciating the variety of vegetable dishes and complimentary drinks in the lounge. Visitors consistently praise the attentive and professional staff, noting their exceptional hospitality and helpfulness.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the southwestern mountains of Niseko Annupuri. The largest hot spring area in Niseko, spanning across the adjacent Rankoshi Town. Experience nature in all four seasons and enjoy strolling through the hot spring town in a yukata. Designated as a national health resort.

name: ニセコ東山（ニセコ温泉郷）
location: 北海道 虻田郡ニセコ町
sales_point: ニセコアンヌプリの南東側山麓に位置する温泉地。ニセコ東山スキー場の中にあるリゾート。羊蹄山の眺望が良い。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hotel offers convenient ski-in/ski-out access with a gondola right outside, and features a beautiful onsen with mountain views. They also highlight the exceptional and warm hospitality from the staff, and the delicious, varied breakfast buffet.

Some reviews mention the rooms can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the southeastern foot of Mount Niseko Annupuri. A resort located within the Niseko Higashiyama Ski Resort, offering great views of Mount Yotei.

name: ニセコ湯本(ニセコ温泉郷）
location: 北海道 磯谷郡蘭越町
sales_point: チセヌプリの南側山腹に位置する温泉地。大湯沼を泉源とし、1000㎡の大露天風呂がある。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the southern slope of Chisenupuri. Features a large outdoor bath of 1000 square meters sourced from Oyunuma. Designated as a national health resort.

name: ニセコワイス高原温泉
location: 北海道 虻田郡倶知安町
sales_point: 標高1048ｍのワイスホルンの山麓に位置する温泉地。ニセコ連峰や羊蹄山の眺望が素晴らしい。ワイススキー場、花園スキー場、花園牧場が近い。
review_summary:
Reviewers praise this onsen for its excellent value at 500 yen for day use, noting its natural hot spring water warms the body and the clean atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the food can be disappointing and the facilities can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Weisshorn Mountain at an elevation of 1048 meters. Offers stunning views of the Niseko mountain range and Mount Yotei. Close to Weiss Ski Resort, Hanazono Ski Resort, and Hanazono Ranch.

name: ニニウ温泉
location: 北海道 勇払郡占冠村
sales_point: 「ニニウ自然の国」の中に位置する温泉地。キャンプ場やサイクリングロード等のアウトドアの素材が豊富。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located within the 'Niniw Nature Country.' Abundant outdoor activities such as campgrounds and cycling paths.

name: 仁山温泉
location: 北海道 亀田郡七飯町
sales_point: ニヤマ高原スキー場の裾野に位置する温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of the Niyama Kogen Ski Resort.

name: ぬかびら源泉郷
location: 北海道 河東郡上士幌町
sales_point: 糠平湖の湖畔に位置する温泉地。ウペペサンケ山の東南側山麓にあり、自然環境が良い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the shores of Lake Nukabira. Situated on the southeastern foot of Mount Upepesanke, it offers a good natural environment.

name: 根崎温泉
location: 北海道 函館市
sales_point: 松倉川河口、津軽海峡沿いに位置する温泉地。湯川海水浴場が目前に広がり、津軽海峡を一望できる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the mouth of the Matsukura River along the Tsugaru Strait. The Yuwakawa beach is right in front, offering a panoramic view of the Tsugaru Strait.

name: ねとい温泉
location: 北海道 久遠郡せたな町
sales_point: 平坦地にある一軒宿の温泉地。温泉は石油を掘っている際に湧いたもの。閑静な環境で保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area with a single inn located in a flat area. The hot spring water emerged while drilling for oil. It is suitable for recuperation and therapy in a quiet environment.

name: 登別温泉
location: 北海道 登別市
spa_quality: 酸性泉、硫黄泉(硫化水素型)、含鉄泉、炭酸水素塩泉、硫酸塩泉
sales_point: クスソサンベツ川沿いの山あいに位置する温泉地。豊富な湯量と多種の泉質を誇り、わが国を代表する温泉地のひとつ。ダイナミックな景観の地獄谷やクマ牧場などがある。。
spa_quality_en: Acidic Spring, 硫黄泉(硫化水素型), Iron Spring, Bicarbonate Spring, Sulfate Spring
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains along the Kususosabetsu River. It boasts abundant hot water and various types of mineral springs, making it one of Japan's representative hot spring destinations. It features dynamic landscapes like Hell Valley and a bear ranch.

name: 函館温泉
location: 北海道 函館市
spa_quality: ナトリウム－塩化物泉（中性高張性高温泉）
sales_point: 函館朝市徒歩2分の好立地に位置する温泉地。函館最大級のSPAゾーンは2フロアにまたがり、直径20メートルを超える天空露天風呂からは函館山や海を一望できる。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers a wide variety of baths, including multiple indoor pools with varying temperatures, a sauna, and a unique star-shaped outdoor bath. They also highlight the excellent water quality, noting the brown, iron-rich water warms the body thoroughly and prevents chills. Visitors appreciate the affordable entry fee and the spacious, clean facilities, including ample washing areas and free lockers.
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム－塩化物泉（中性高張性高温泉）
sales_point_en: Located just a 2-minute walk from Hakodate Morning Market, this hot spring area features one of Hakodate's largest spa zones spanning two floors, with an open-air bath over 20 meters in diameter offering views of Mount Hakodate and the sea.

name: 函館市内の温泉
location: 北海道 函館市
review_summary: People say this onsen offers a wide variety of baths, including multiple indoor pools with varying temperatures, a sauna, and a unique star-shaped outdoor bath. They also highlight the excellent water quality, noting the brown, iron-rich water warms the body thoroughly and prevents chills. Visitors appreciate the affordable entry fee and the spacious, clean facilities, including ample washing areas and free lockers.

name: はぼろ温泉
location: 北海道 苫前郡羽幌町
sales_point: 日本海を望む、海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。近くにバラ園があり「道の駅」にも指定されている。「はぼろ温泉(サンセットプラザはぼろ)」は日帰り入浴も可能。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers delicious seafood, including sweet shrimp and sashimi boat platters, and features spacious indoor baths with rich hot spring water. They also highlight the friendly staff and the convenient location with a roadside station and clean restrooms.

Other reviews mention the facility can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the coast with views of the Sea of Japan. There is a nearby rose garden, and it is designated as a 'Roadside Station.' 'Habro Onsen (Sunset Plaza Habro)' offers day-use bathing.

name: 浜頓別温泉
location: 北海道 枝幸郡浜頓別町
sales_point: クッチャロ湖畔にある温泉地。春と秋に飛来してくる２万羽以上の白鳥の群とクッチャロ湖を一望できる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by Lake Kuccharo. It offers a view of over 20,000 swans that migrate in spring and autumn, along with the scenic Lake Kuccharo.

name: 浜松温泉
location: 北海道 二海郡八雲町
sales_point: 内浦湾を望む海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。国道5号線沿いにある。
review_summary:
Guests consistently praise this hotel for its fresh and delicious seafood and its relaxing onsen, which includes a sauna.

Other reviews mention the service can be impolite and the facilities can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the coast with views of Uchiura Bay, situated along National Route 5.

name: 蟠渓温泉
location: 北海道 有珠郡壮瞥町
sales_point: 長流川沿いの山あいに位置する温泉地。素朴な雰囲気でオロフレ峠付近の眺望が良い。特に紅葉の時期は素晴らしい。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains along the Nagauru River. It has a rustic atmosphere and offers great views near the Orofure Pass, especially stunning during the autumn foliage season.

name: 晩成温泉
location: 北海道 広尾郡大樹町
sales_point: 十勝地方で唯一海を眺めながら入浴できる温泉地。温泉成分中にヨードを大量に含んでおり、身体がとてもあたたまる。館内の食堂にて、ご当地グルメの「大樹チーズサーモン丼」を食べることができる。
review_summary: People say this hot spring features a rare, high-concentration iodine spring with a unique reddish-brown color and a distinct scent, offering excellent warming and moisturizing effects. Visitors also highlight the affordable 500 yen admission fee, which includes rental bath and face towels, along with a wide array of complimentary amenities. They also like the ocean views from the bathing area and the relaxing outdoor terrace.
sales_point_en: The only hot spring area in the Tokachi region where you can bathe while enjoying views of the sea. It contains a large amount of iodine in its mineral content, providing warmth to the body. You can also enjoy the local gourmet dish 'Taiki Cheese Salmon Bowl' at the on-site dining area.

name: 東大沼温泉
location: 北海道 亀田郡七飯町
sales_point: 駒ヶ岳東側山麓に位置する温泉地。道南の主要観光地大沼にあり、原生林に囲まれ、自然環境が良い。
