sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the eastern foot of Mount Komagatake. It is situated in Onuma, a major tourist destination in southern Hokkaido, surrounded by primeval forests and a good natural environment.

name: 日向温泉
location: 北海道 士別市
sales_point: 日向森林公園内に位置する温泉地。夏はキャンプ、冬はスキーが楽しめる。めん羊館や士別不動尊自然公園が近い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located within Hinata Forest Park. Enjoy camping in the summer and skiing in the winter. Nearby attractions include the Sheep Pavilion and Shibetsu Fudoson Nature Park.

name: 平田内温泉
location: 北海道 二海郡八雲町
sales_point: 平田内川沿いに位置する温泉地。付近は平田内渓谷と呼ばれ、自然環境が良く秋の紅葉は素晴らしい。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Hiratanai River. The surrounding area is known as Hiratanai Valley, offering a good natural environment and stunning autumn foliage.

name: ひらふ温泉
location: 北海道 虻田郡倶知安町
sales_point: ニセコアンヌプリ東側中腹に位置する温泉地。正面に羊蹄山を望み眺望が良い。通年趣を感じ取ることができる。冬はスキー客で賑わう。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the eastern slope of Mount Niseko Annupuri. It offers great views of Mount Yotei and a year-round charming atmosphere, bustling with skiers in winter.

name: 美深温泉
location: 北海道 中川郡美深町
sales_point: 森林公園、キャンプ場、道の駅が併設されている。びふかアイランド内に湧く温泉。緑豊かな環境。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring inn offers unique sturgeon dishes, including caviar, and features a natural hot spring with large windows. They also highlight the reasonable prices, quiet atmosphere, and helpful staff.

Other reviews mention the restaurant can be unavailable.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area with a forest park, campground, and roadside station. The hot spring emerges within Bifuka Island, surrounded by lush greenery.

name: 美幌温泉
location: 北海道 網走郡美幌町
sales_point: 美幌町北部に位置する温泉地。周囲は畑で、プールやゴルフなどの施設も併設されている。日帰り入浴も可。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring offers a variety of baths, including jacuzzis, jet baths, medicinal baths, saunas, and open-air options, with good water quality. They also highlight the clean, warm, and bright restrooms, and the affordable meal sets that include bathing tickets.

Some reviews mention the facility can be crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northern part of Bihoro Town. Surrounded by fields, it also features facilities such as a pool and golf course. Day-use bathing is available.

name: 平取温泉
location: 北海道 沙流郡平取町
sales_point: 沙流川が流れる平取町に位置する温泉地。近くには二風谷ファミリーランドやアイヌ文化資料館などの見所もある。
review_summary: People say this onsen features clean facilities, including a high-concentration carbonated bath, a spacious outdoor bath, and a variety of other baths. They also highlight the delicious meals, especially the high-quality Biratori wagyu beef dishes, and the reasonable prices for both bathing and dining. Guests mention the quiet and relaxing atmosphere, along with the welcoming and attentive staff.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in Biratori Town along the Saru River. Nearby attractions include the Nibutani Family Land and the Ainu Cultural Museum.

name: ピリカ温泉
location: 北海道 瀬棚郡今金町
sales_point: 美利河ダムの近くに位置する温泉地。周辺にはスキー場、キャンプ場、パークゴルフ場等の野外施設が充実している。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the Birikawa Dam. The surrounding area is rich in outdoor facilities such as ski resorts, campgrounds, and park golf courses.

name: 敏音知温泉
location: 北海道 枝幸郡中頓別町
sales_point: 敏音知岳の麓にある閑静な温泉地。道の駅、オートキャンプ場等が隣接する。
sales_point_en: A quiet hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Mikune. It is adjacent to a roadside station and an auto campground.

name: 深川温泉
location: 北海道 深川市
sales_point: 深川市南部の丘陵地に位置する温泉地。アイスクリーム、アップルパイ、そばなどの加工実習が体験できる研修施設が併設されている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including jet-equipped indoor baths, jacuzzis, saunas, and three outdoor rotenburo, with some featuring large and small壺湯 (tsuboyu) barrel baths. Visitors also highlight the affordable 500 yen entry fee, the delicious restaurant food, and the pleasant, relaxing atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the staff can be impolite.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the hilly region of southern Fukagawa City. It features a training facility where you can experience making ice cream, apple pie, and soba noodles.

name: 吹上温泉
location: 北海道 空知郡上富良野町
sales_point: 北海道の中央部、大雪山国立公園内に位置する高原の温泉地。自然環境に恵まれ、保養・登山に好適。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers a wide variety of baths, including indoor, outdoor, and mixed-gender options, along with a sauna and cold bath. They also highlight the reasonable 700 yen entry fee and the option to stay all day, with amenities like a rest area and vending machines. Guests mention the staff are friendly and helpful, and the facility is kept clean and well-maintained.
sales_point_en: A highland hot spring area located in the center of Hokkaido, within Daisetsuzan National Park. Blessed with a natural environment, it is ideal for relaxation and mountain climbing. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 伏見温泉
location: 北海道 夕張郡由仁町
sales_point: 由仁町西部の丘陵地に位置する温泉地。ユンニの湯と称し、肌に優しいコーヒー色のお湯が好評。周辺にはスポーツ施設が豊富。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a unique coffee-colored "moor" spring that leaves skin feeling smooth and moisturized, along with spacious bathing areas and a hot sauna. They also highlight the friendly staff, comfortable rest areas, and delicious food options.

Some reviews mention the bathing areas can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the hilly region of western Yuni Town. Known as Yunni no Yu, the gentle coffee-colored water is popular for its skin-friendly properties. The surrounding area is rich in sports facilities.

name: 富士見温泉
location: 北海道 稚内市
sales_point: 日本最北端に位置する温泉地。浴場は道北最大級の広さを誇り、10種類の浴槽を楽しめる。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen offers a wide variety of baths, including open-air, jet, and medicinal options, with views of Rishiri Fuji from the outdoor bath. They also highlight the reasonable 600 yen admission fee and the availability of shampoo and body soap.

Some reviews mention that impolite local patrons can negatively affect the atmosphere.
sales_point_en: The northernmost hot spring area in Japan. The bathing facilities boast one of the largest sizes in the northern region, offering ten different types of baths.

name: 二股ラジウム温泉
location: 北海道 山越郡長万部町
sales_point: 川股川上流の谷あいに位置する温泉地。温泉の成分が析出してできた石灰華のドームが名物となっている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has excellent water quality with abundant "yunohana" (mineral deposits), and features various baths, including a deep indoor bath, open-air bath, and a pool. They also highlight the simple, delicious meals and the friendly, helpful staff.

Some reviews mention the service can be unprofessional.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a valley upstream of the Kawamata River. The limestone dome formed by the precipitation of hot spring components is a local specialty.

name: 太美温泉
location: 北海道 石狩郡当別町
sales_point: 石狩川の北側、石狩太美駅近くに位置する温泉地。雄大な石狩平野を眺望できる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has a wide variety of baths, including a spacious open-air bath with stunning views, and the water leaves skin feeling smooth. They also highlight the comprehensive amenities, comfortable relaxation areas, and friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the food can be expensive.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near Taimi Station on the north side of the Ishikari River. It offers a magnificent view of the Ishikari Plain.

name: 別海温泉
location: 北海道 野付郡別海町
sales_point: 別海市街の高台にあり、町並みを一望できる温泉地。周辺には新酪農村のサイロが点在する。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including hot and lukewarm options, with two distinct natural spring sources. Guests mention the affordable 500 yen entry fee and the friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be neglected.
sales_point_en: Situated on a hill overlooking the town of Betsukai, this hot spring area provides a panoramic view of the townscape. The surrounding area is dotted with silos from the new dairy farming village.

name: 北竜温泉
location: 北海道 雨竜郡北竜町
sales_point: 国道275号線沿いの道の駅サンフラワー北竜に隣接する温泉地。露天風呂・サウナを完備した施設が好評。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including open-air, mist, and dry saunas, and the water leaves skin feeling smooth. They also highlight the affordable 500 yen admission fee and the delicious sunflower soft-serve ice cream.

Some reviews mention the staff can be unhelpful.
sales_point_en: Adjacent to the Sunflower Kitahiro roadside station along National Route 275, this hot spring area is popular for its outdoor baths and sauna facilities.

name: 幌加温泉
location: 北海道 河東郡上士幌町
sales_point: ニペソツ山の東側山麓に位置する温泉地。大自然に囲まれた山峡の閑静な環境にある。
review_summary: People say this onsen features three types of hot springs, including calcium, iron, and sodium, and a unique open-air bath with stunning natural views. They also highlight the spotless facilities, despite the building's age, and the availability of cooking utensils for guests. Guests mention the staff's hospitality and the respectful atmosphere among visitors.
sales_point_en: Located at the eastern foot of Mount Nipponsetsu, this hot spring area is surrounded by nature in a tranquil mountain valley.

name: 幌新温泉
location: 北海道 雨竜郡沼田町
sales_point: 幌新ダム付近の山あいに位置する温泉地。自然に恵まれた閑静な環境にある。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring inn offers a wide variety of facilities, including a spacious gym, a sauna, and an open-air bath with unique electric features. They also highlight the all-you-can-drink plans, delicious meals, and the smooth, skin-softening quality of the hot spring water.

Some reviews mention the facility can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains near the Horoshin Dam. It is situated in a quiet environment blessed with nature.

name: 本別温泉
location: 北海道 中川郡本別町
sales_point: 本別市街の西方、美里別川の河畔に位置する温泉地。豪壮な日本庭園がある。
sales_point_en: Located west of the town of Honbetsu, along the banks of the Misato Betsu River, this hot spring area features a magnificent Japanese garden.

name: 本別沢温泉
location: 北海道 中川郡本別町
sales_point: 本別市街の東方、本別川の山峡にひらけた本別公園内にある温泉地。エゾムラサキツツジの名所。
sales_point_en: Situated in Honbetsu Park, opened in the mountain valley of the Honbetsu River, east of the town. It is famous for its Ezo Purple Azaleas.

name: ポンピラ温泉
location: 北海道 中川郡中川町
sales_point: 見晴公園の近くに位置する温泉地。ポンピラはアイヌ語で小さなガケのある所という意味。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers clean and spacious rooms, delicious meals, and a relaxing hot bath, with some mentioning good value for money.

Other reviews mention the building can be neglected and the service can be unhelpful.
sales_point_en: Located near Mihara Park, Ponpira means 'a place with a small cliff' in the Ainu language.

name: ポン湯温泉
location: 北海道 北見市
sales_point: ポン湯はアイヌ語で「神の湯」の意味。泉質は殺菌力が強く、皮膚病・やけどに特効がある。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers two types of hot spring baths, a 38°C and a 42°C, both with a unique, skin-softening quality. Guests also highlight the clean, albeit dated, facilities and the relaxing, long-soak friendly atmosphere.

Some reviews mention the water can be lukewarm.
sales_point_en: Ponyu means 'God's hot spring' in Ainu. The water quality has strong antibacterial properties, making it effective for skin diseases and burns.

name: 幕別温泉
location: 北海道 中川郡幕別町
sales_point: 十勝平野を見渡す台地に位置する温泉地。自然林に囲まれた閑静な環境に位置する温泉地で、保養・療養に好適。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: Located on a plateau overlooking the Tokachi Plain, this hot spring area is surrounded by natural forests, providing a quiet environment ideal for relaxation and recuperation. It is designated as a national health resort.

name: 摩周温泉
location: 北海道 川上郡弟子屈町
sales_point: 弟子屈町の中心、釧路川と鐺別川の合流点に位置する温泉地。交通の便が良く、阿寒・摩周観光の拠点に好適。かつては弟子屈温泉とも呼ばれた。
review_summary:
Visitors appreciate this roadside station for its relaxing free footbath, good souvenirs, delicious soft-serve ice cream and venison burgers, clean restrooms, and ample parking. Its convenient location is also a highlight for those exploring nearby lakes.

Other reviews mention there can be a limited product selection.
sales_point_en: Located at the confluence of the Kushiro River and the Tōbetsu River in the center of Teshikaga Town, this hot spring area is conveniently located for tourism in Akan and Mashu. It was once called Teshikaga Onsen.

name: 松前温泉
location: 北海道 松前郡松前町
sales_point: 北海道の南西端、大沢川流域に位置する温泉地。白神岬からは青森県を遠望することができる。静かな環境にあり、保養・静養にも好適。日帰り入浴も可。
sales_point_en: Located at the southwestern tip of Hokkaido, in the Oosawa River basin. From Shirakami Cape, you can see Aomori Prefecture in the distance. It is in a quiet environment, suitable for relaxation and recuperation, with day-use bathing available.

name: 丸瀬布温泉
location: 北海道 紋別郡遠軽町
sales_point: 武利川上流の山あいに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、町営の日帰り温泉施設では10種の入浴が楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a small but clean indoor bath, an open-air bath, and a unique wood-fired sauna. Guests also highlight the smooth, alkaline spring water and the reasonable 600 yen entry fee.

Some reviews mention the changing room can be small.
sales_point_en: Situated in the mountains upstream of the Takuri River, this hot spring area is in a quiet environment, and the town-operated day-use hot spring facility offers ten types of baths.

name: 万字温泉
location: 北海道 岩見沢市
sales_point: 栗沢町東部の山あいに位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれ紅葉の穴場。リンゴ風呂や丸木風呂がある。
sales_point_en: Located in the mountains of eastern Kurisawa Town, this hot spring area is blessed with a natural environment and is a hidden gem for autumn foliage. It features apple baths and log baths.

name: 三笠温泉
location: 北海道 三笠市
sales_point: 幾春別川中流の河畔にある温泉地。宿の目の前にある吊り橋が名物となっている。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers spacious and clean rooms, along with a large, well-maintained onsen with multiple baths, saunas, and rock saunas. They also highlight the delicious breakfast buffet, convenient location near a roadside station and supermarket, and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the food can be inconsistent.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the banks of the Ikushunbetsu River. A suspension bridge in front of the inn is a local attraction.

name: みさき温泉
location: 北海道 苫前郡初山別村
sales_point: 日本海を見晴らす台地に位置する温泉地。公共の施設がある。夕日を眺めながらの入浴は最高。付近には天文台施設もある。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers a relaxing experience with a variety of baths, including an open-air bath with ocean views, and a sauna. Visitors also highlight the affordable 500 yen entrance fee, complimentary body soap and shampoo, and free lockers. Guests mention the facility is clean and well-maintained, with convenient amenities for campers.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a plateau overlooking the Sea of Japan. It has public facilities, and bathing while watching the sunset is exceptional. There is also an observatory facility nearby.

name: 三石温泉
location: 北海道 日高郡新ひだか町
sales_point: 三石ファミリーパーク内に位置する温泉地。太平洋を望む風光明媚な環境にある施設は、町営の老人福祉センターになっている。
review_summary:
Guests mention this onsen features a unique boat-shaped outdoor bath with ocean views, a variety of indoor baths, and a spacious sauna. They also highlight the reasonable admission fee, complimentary amenities, and attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the ocean view can be obstructed.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located within Mitsuishi Family Park, offering scenic views of the Pacific Ocean. The facility serves as a municipal welfare center for the elderly.

name: 緑の村温泉
location: 北海道 苫前郡羽幌町
sales_point: ピッシリ山の西側山麓、築別川沿いに位置する温泉地。山あいの静かな環境にあり、保養・静養に好適。水道面での故障により休止中。再開の予定不明。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers delicious seafood, including sweet shrimp and sashimi boat platters, and features spacious indoor baths with rich hot spring water. They also highlight the friendly staff and the convenient location with a roadside station and clean restrooms.

Other reviews mention the facility can be dated.
sales_point_en: Situated along the Chikubetsu River at the western foot of Pissiri Mountain, this hot spring is in a quiet mountain environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. Currently closed due to plumbing issues, with no known reopening date.

name: 美流渡温泉
location: 北海道 岩見沢市
sales_point: 山々に囲まれた静かな環境にある温泉地。昔ながらの風情が残されている。釣り堀もある。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a wide variety of baths, including spacious outdoor tubs, and two types of saunas. They also highlight the affordable 500 yen entrance fee and the value of the meal and bath set.

Other reviews mention the staff can be impolite.
sales_point_en: A tranquil hot spring surrounded by mountains, retaining a traditional atmosphere. It also features a fishing pond.

name: 雌阿寒温泉
location: 北海道 足寄郡足寄町
sales_point: 雌阿寒岳西側山麓、標高700ｍに位置する温泉地。アカエゾマツの原生林に囲まれ、静寂な環境にある。国民保養温泉地に指定され、保養・療養に好適。またオンネトー探勝や雌阿寒岳登山の基地にも良い。
sales_point_en: Located at an elevation of 700 meters on the western slope of Meakandake, this hot spring is surrounded by a virgin forest of Akazomatsu, providing a serene environment. Designated as a national health resort, it is suitable for recuperation and also serves as a base for exploring Onneto and climbing Meakandake.

name: 芽登温泉
location: 北海道 足寄郡足寄町
sales_point: ヌナカン川渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。原生林に囲まれて自然が豊かな環境にある。クマネシリ連峰の南登山口。冬期も露天風呂への入浴が可能。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers excellent, authentic hot springs with both hot and lukewarm baths, including a scenic open-air bath by the river. Guests also highlight the delicious and refined meals served in a new dining area, and appreciate the friendly and attentive staff.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located along the Nunakan River, surrounded by virgin forests, offering a rich natural environment. It is the southern trailhead for the Kumane-shiri mountain range, and outdoor baths are available even in winter.

name: 女満別温泉
location: 北海道 網走郡大空町
sales_point: 網走湖の南岸に位置する温泉地。町内に宿泊施設や温泉施設が点在している。
sales_point_en: Located on the southern shore of Lake Abashiri, this hot spring area has various accommodations and facilities scattered throughout the town.

name: 毛陽町温泉
location: 北海道 岩見沢市
sales_point: 岩見沢市の東方、山間部に位置する温泉地。ログハウス造りの温泉で、野外には運動施設完備。
review_summary: People say this hotel offers delicious French-inspired course dinners, with many highlighting the exquisite bagna cauda and flavorful soups. They also appreciate the natural hot spring baths, which have a smooth, moisturizing quality, and the excellent Finnish-style saunas with self-löyly. Guests mention the attentive staff, the cozy lodge-style rooms with pleasant aromas, and complimentary amenities like ice cream and drinks.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the mountainous area east of Iwamizawa, featuring log cabin-style facilities and outdoor sports amenities.

name: 藻琴山温泉
location: 北海道 網走郡大空町
sales_point: 屈斜路湖カルデラの外輪山、藻琴山麓に位置する温泉地。芝桜公園の中にあり、自然環境が良い。ハイキングの足場にも好適。
sales_point_en: Situated at the foot of Mokoto Mountain on the outer rim of the Kussharo Caldera, this hot spring is located within a park of shiba sakura (moss phlox), offering a pleasant natural environment and suitable for hiking.

name: 藻琴山高原温泉
location: 北海道 網走郡大空町
sales_point: 藻琴山登山口に位置する温泉地。オホーツク海と知床連山を一望できる。手つかずの自然が残る藻琴山は野鳥、植物の宝庫。
sales_point_en: Located at the trailhead of Mokoto Mountain, this hot spring offers panoramic views of the Sea of Okhotsk and the Shiretoko mountain range. Mokoto Mountain is a treasure trove of untouched nature, home to various birds and plants.

name: 茂津多海岸温泉
location: 北海道 島牧郡島牧村
sales_point: 栄浜近くの海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。日本海を望みながらの入浴が楽しめる。日本有数の天然ラジウム温泉。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers pure, unfiltered hot spring baths with both hot indoor and slightly warmer outdoor options, providing stunning ocean views from the open-air bath. They also highlight the delicious seafood meals, reasonable prices, and the quiet, relaxing atmosphere. Visitors appreciate the convenient Wi-Fi and comfortable room wear.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located along the coast near Sakaehama, allowing guests to enjoy bathing while overlooking the Japan Sea. It is one of Japan's premier natural radium hot springs.

name: 紋別温泉
location: 北海道 紋別市
sales_point: 紋別市役所南方約1キロの市街地に位置する温泉地。紋別に新しくホワイトビーチがオープンし海中を見学できる施設ができた。冬にはそこから流氷を見学できる。毛ガニやカレイが名産品として有名。
review_summary:
Visitors praise this bathhouse for its variety of baths with different temperatures, including a cold water bath, and its spacious resting area.

Other reviews mention the open-air bath can be closed and some areas can be neglected.
sales_point_en: Located about 1 kilometer south of Mombetsu City Hall, this hot spring area has recently opened a new White Beach facility where visitors can observe the underwater world. In winter, it offers views of drifting ice.

name: 薬師(ニセコ温泉郷）
location: 北海道 磯谷郡蘭越町
sales_point: 明治24年の開湯で、100年以上の歴史を持つ。濁湯と透明湯があり療養効果が高いと言われる。
sales_point_en: Established in 1891, this hot spring has over 100 years of history. It features both cloudy and clear waters, known for their high therapeutic effects.

name: 八雲温泉
location: 北海道 二海郡八雲町
sales_point: 鉛川沿いに位置する山あいの温泉地。四季折々の自然や露天風呂が楽しめる。
review_summary:
Guests consistently praise this hotel for its fresh and delicious seafood and its relaxing onsen, which includes a sauna.

Other reviews mention the service can be impolite and the facilities can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A mountain hot spring located along the Lead River, offering seasonal natural beauty and outdoor baths.

name: 谷地頭温泉
location: 北海道 函館市
sales_point: 函館山の東麓に位置する温泉地。湯は湧出時は無色だが、時間が経つにつれて褐色となる。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers a wide variety of baths, including multiple indoor pools with varying temperatures, a sauna, and a unique star-shaped outdoor bath. They also highlight the excellent water quality, noting the brown, iron-rich water warms the body thoroughly and prevents chills. Visitors appreciate the affordable entry fee and the spacious, clean facilities, including ample washing areas and free lockers.
sales_point_en: Located at the eastern foot of Mount Hakodate, the water is colorless when it first flows out but turns brown over time.

name: 山花温泉
location: 北海道 釧路市
sales_point: 釧路市郊外北西の山花公園内にある温泉地。園内にはオートキャンプ場、動物園、ホースパークも併設。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a wide variety of baths, including spacious indoor and outdoor rotenburo, jet baths, and saunas. They also highlight the affordable day-use plans, delicious soft-serve ice cream, and family-friendly amenities.

Some reviews mention there can be a lack of toiletries.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located within Yamahana Park, northwest of Kushiro City. The park also features an auto camping site, a zoo, and a horse park.

name: 湯の川温泉
location: 北海道 函館市
sales_point: 津軽海峡に注ぐ松倉川沿いに位置する道内でも有数の温泉地。大森海岸の漁り火で有名。
sales_point_en: One of the leading hot springs in Hokkaido, located along the Matsukura River, which flows into the Tsugaru Strait. It is famous for its fishing fires along Omori Beach.

name: 湯の里温泉
location: 北海道 上磯郡知内町
sales_point: 開湯から800年を数える温泉地。深閑とした自然に囲まれた天然温泉。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers excellent hot springs, including a "beauty" bath and a "fatigue-relief" bath, along with a highly-rated sauna. They also highlight the delicious meals, especially fresh oysters, and the friendly, attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the hot springs can be too hot.
sales_point_en: This hot spring has a history of over 800 years since its opening. It is a natural hot spring surrounded by tranquil nature.

name: 湯の里(ニセコ温泉郷）
location: 北海道 磯谷郡蘭越町
sales_point: ニセコのペンション街に位置する温泉地。リゾート感覚に満ちた独特の雰囲気を持ち若者に好評。
sales_point_en: Located in the pension district of Niseko, this hot spring has a unique resort-like atmosphere that is popular among young people.

name: 湯の沢温泉
location: 北海道 勇払郡占冠村
sales_point: 山あいに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で保養・療養に好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a relaxing atmosphere with a warm main bath, a cold plunge, and a small sauna, and many appreciate the unique, gentle quality of the hot spring water. They also highlight the friendly staff, delicious meals, and affordable day-use fees.

Other reviews mention the bath can be too deep.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in a mountain area, ideal for relaxation and recuperation in a quiet environment.

name: 湯の沢温泉
location: 北海道 目梨郡羅臼町
sales_point: 羅臼市街から山側3キロ程の羅臼川沿いの山間に位置する温泉地。羅臼岳への登山基地となっている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a relaxing atmosphere with a warm main bath, a cold plunge, and a small sauna, and many appreciate the unique, gentle quality of the hot spring water. They also highlight the friendly staff, delicious meals, and affordable day-use fees.

Other reviews mention the bath can be too deep.
sales_point_en: Situated along the Rausu River about 3 kilometers from Rausu town, this hot spring serves as a base for climbing Rausu Mountain.

name: 湯ノ岱温泉
location: 北海道 桧山郡上ノ国町
sales_point: 北海道南端の天ノ川の清流沿いにある温泉地。檜山道立自然公園の東方に位置し、自然環境がよい。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary: People say this onsen features excellent quality carbonated spring water with three different temperature baths, including a comfortable warm bath perfect for long soaks. They also highlight the affordable 350 yen entry fee and the availability of free dryers and lockers. Others also say the staff are friendly and the spacious rest area is ideal for relaxing after a bath.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the clear stream of Amanogawa at the southern tip of Hokkaido. Positioned east of Hiyama Prefectural Natural Park, it boasts a great natural environment and is designated as a national health resort.

name: 養老牛温泉
location: 北海道 標津郡中標津町
sales_point: 中標津町の西方、標津岳の南麓の沢沿いに位置する温泉地。針葉樹の自然林に囲まれた秘湯。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along a stream at the southern foot of Shibetsu Mountain, west of Nakashibetsu. It is a hidden hot spring surrounded by coniferous natural forests.

name: 雷電温泉
location: 北海道 岩内郡岩内町
sales_point: 日本海の海岸沿いに面している温泉郷。義経伝説が伝えられる雷電岬、弁慶の刀掛岩を近くに望め、夕陽がとても美しい。
sales_point_en: A hot spring resort facing the coast of the Sea of Japan. Close to Raiden Cape, known for the legend of Yoshitsune, and Benkei's Sword Rack Rock, it offers stunning views of the sunset.

name: 利尻冨士温泉
location: 北海道 利尻郡利尻冨士町
sales_point: 利尻昆布とウニの町として有名な利尻富士町に位置する温泉地。利尻川の北側山裾にあり、町内観光の拠点にも便利。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features a variety of baths, including a comfortable outdoor rotenburo, a sauna, and a very cold water bath. They also highlight the clean facilities, convenient amenities like lockers and dryers, and the reasonable 500 yen admission fee. Guests mention the relaxing atmosphere, especially after hiking, and appreciate the tattoo-friendly policy.
sales_point_en: Located in Rishiri Fuji Town, famous for Rishiri kelp and sea urchins. Situated at the foot of the mountains on the north side of the Rishiri River, it is also a convenient base for local sightseeing.

name: 留真温泉
location: 北海道 十勝郡浦幌町
sales_point: 浦幌町中部の留真川沿いに位置する温泉地。山峡の閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a high-alkaline spring water that leaves skin feeling smooth and soft, along with clean and modern facilities. They also highlight the reasonable 500 yen admission fee, which includes shampoo, conditioner, and body soap. Guests mention the staff are friendly and helpful, and the soft-serve ice cream is delicious.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Ruma River in the central part of Urahoro Town. It is in a quiet mountain valley environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: ワイス温泉
location: 北海道 岩内郡共和町
sales_point: リューマチ、創傷等に効果があるといわれ、山菜採りの愛好家たちが立ち寄る温泉。
review_summary:
Reviewers praise this onsen for its excellent value at 500 yen for day use, noting its natural hot spring water warms the body and the clean atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the food can be disappointing and the facilities can be dated.
sales_point_en: Said to be effective for rheumatism and wounds, this hot spring is a popular stop for enthusiasts of wild vegetable picking.

name: 和琴温泉
location: 北海道 川上郡弟子屈町
sales_point: 和琴半島の付け根に位置する温泉地。湖中に湧く温泉で、自然探勝路入口にある湖面を眺めながら露天風呂でゆったりとくつろげる。
review_summary:
Visitors say this wild hot spring offers magnificent views of the lake and surrounding mountains, with a pleasant water temperature that can be adjusted. They also highlight the free, 24-hour access and the unique experience of soaking with swans in winter.

Other reviews mention the property can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the base of Wakoto Peninsula. The hot spring emerges from the lake, allowing visitors to relax in an outdoor bath while enjoying views of the lake surface at the entrance to nature trails.
